title: Non-Metricity Corrections Approach to Alleviate H0 Tension: The Logarithmic and Nonlinear f(Q) Models
abstractText: Abstract The persistent discrepancy between early-time and late-Universe measurements of the Hubble constant commonly known as the $H_0$ tension remains one of the most pressing open questions in modern cosmology. In this work, we explore whether modifications to the gravitational sector, specifically within the framework of symmetric teleparallel gravity, can offer a viable pathway toward alleviating this tension. We consider two functional forms of f(Q) gravity: a logarithmic model and a nonlinear saturation model, both of which introduce geometric corrections to the standard expansion history without invoking a cosmological constant. Constraining these models through a Bayesian MCMC analysis against a comprehensive suite of observational data, including CC, Type Ia supernovae compilations (Pantheon, Pantheon+SH0ES, and DES SN5YR), and BAO measurements from SDSS and DESI, we find that both models remain statistically competitive with \LambdaCDM. The logarithmic model yields H_0 values that reduce the statistical discrepancy with the SH0ES determination for the considered late-time dataset combinations, with the residual tension quantified using a standard \sigma-based tension metric. Although the AIC, BIC, and DIC information criteria marginally prefer \LambdaCDM over the extended models, the results indicate that the logarithmic model can partially alleviate the H_0 tension for the late-time datasets considered, with the degree of alleviation depending on the specific combination of observations, providing a phenomenological assessment of late-time H_0 tension within the modified gravity framework.

title: Baryon Asymmetry Transfer to Majorana Dark Matter from a Colored Partner
abstractText: Abstract We propose a mechanism in which a primordial baryon asymmetry determines the relic abundance of self-conjugate dark matter through a heavier partner sector. In a simplified model with a Majorana fermion $\chi$ and a colored scalar partner $\tilde q$, QCD annihilations deplete the symmetric partner population while a residual asymmetric component survives as a temporary reservoir. For feeble portal couplings, this asymmetry is transferred to $\chi$ at late times, after dark matter freeze-out. The final relic abundance is controlled by the amount of surviving asymmetry, the timing of its transfer, and the subsequent dark matter annihilation. Solving the coupled Boltzmann equations with the relevant chemical-potential effects, we find that an intermediate range of portal couplings can reproduce the observed relic abundance without requiring a compressed mass spectrum. This is in contrast to conventional coannihilation and conversion-driven freeze-out scenarios, where the heavier partner abundance is Boltzmann suppressed and a nearly degenerate spectrum, $m_{\tilde q}\simeq m_\chi$, is therefore typically required for the partner to remain sufficiently abundant to affect the dark matter relic abundance. In our mechanism, the relevant reservoir is the surviving asymmetric component of the partner population, which is not determined by the Boltzmann-suppressed thermal abundance of the heavier partner, allowing the mechanism to operate even for $m_{\tilde q}\gg m_\chi$. The qualitative mechanism remains robust against variations in the mass hierarchy, dark matter annihilation mode, and lepton asymmetry. The small portal couplings also make the colored partner potentially long lived, allowing LHC searches for heavy long-lived particles to constrain part of the viable parameter space.

title: Serum Olink proteomics-based exploration of novel predictive biomarkers for necrotizing enterocolitis
abstractText: Necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC) is a life-threatening gastrointestinal emergency in preterm infants, yet reliable serum candidates for presymptomatic risk stratification remain lacking. In this exploratory study, serial pre-diagnostic serum samples from a prospective discovery cohort were profiled using the Olink proteomics platform. NEC cases and controls were individually matched for gestational age, birth weight, and sampling time. Top-ranked proteins were assessed via enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay in an independent validation cohort and examined in surgical intestinal tissues. Fibroblast growth factor 5 (FGF5) showed the highest discriminative performance with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.848. Lower circulating FGF5 levels were reproduced in the validation cohort, although the apparently perfect discrimination was imprecise because of the small sample size. Intestinal FGF5 expression was also reduced in NEC specimens. These findings support FGF5 as a promising exploratory biomarker for early NEC risk assessment, warranting larger multicenter validation and mechanistic investigation.

title: Temporal distribution of recorded indications for first revision total knee arthroplasty: a multicenter Chilean cohort of 150 patients
abstractText: INTRODUCTION: /Objectives: Recorded indications for first revision total knee arthroplasty (TKA) may vary with time after the primary procedure. This study compared their distribution among early and late first revisions in a multicentre Chilean cohort. METHODS: This retrospective non-consecutive cohort included 150 unique patients who underwent first revision TKA at five Chilean centres between 2018 and 2026. Revisions were classified as early (<24 months) or late (≥24 months). Indication distributions were compared using categorical tests, including a fixed-margin Monte Carlo procedure for sparse cells. Logistic regression adjusted for age and sex. Sensitivity analyses incorporated revision year and centre and modelled time continuously, including assessment of non-linearity. RESULTS: Mean age was 70.1±9.5 years, and 97 patients (64.7%) were women. Fifty-three revisions (35.3%) were early and 97 (64.7%) were late. The indication distribution differed by timing (Monte Carlo p=0.0003; Cramér's V=0.41). Infection was the most frequent early indication (18/53, 34.0%), whereas aseptic loosening accounted for more than half of late revisions (52/97, 53.6%). After adjustment for age and sex, late revision was associated with higher odds that aseptic loosening was the recorded indication (adjusted odds ratio [OR], 6.70; 95% confidence interval [CI], 2.80-16.00; p<0.001). Early revision was associated with higher odds that infection was the recorded indication (adjusted OR, 3.21; 95% CI, 1.40-7.34; p=0.006). Estimates were similar after accounting for revision year and centre and when time was analysed continuously. CONCLUSION: Among the included first revisions, infection was the most frequent recorded indication before 24 months, whereas aseptic loosening was the most frequent indication thereafter. These within-cohort associations remain subject to selection bias, diagnostic misclassification and residual confounding, and do not estimate cause-specific revision risk after primary TKA. LEVEL OF EVIDENCE: III.

title: Perbandingan Pengaruh Latihan Menggunakan Metode drill dan short interval Training Terhadap Kecepatan Renang Gaya Bebas
abstractText: This study aimed to determine the effect of the drill and short-interval training methods on 25-meter freestyle swimming performance. The study employed a quasi-experimental method using a two-group pretest–posttest design. The sample consisted of 25 athletes from Banyu Pratama Swimming Club (BPC), who were divided into two groups: the drill group (10 athletes) and the short-interval group (10 athletes). The research instrument was a 25-meter freestyle swimming test, while data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, the Shapiro–Wilk normality test, and the paired-samples t-test. The results showed that both training methods had a significant effect on 25-meter freestyle swimming performance (p < 0.05). The drill group improved by reducing the mean swimming time from 19.88 seconds to 18.08 seconds, representing an improvement of 1.82 seconds. Meanwhile, the short-interval group reduced the mean swimming time from 19.88 seconds to 19.21 seconds, representing an improvement of 0.66 seconds. Therefore, both training methods were effective in improving 25-meter freestyle swimming performance; however, the drill training method produced greater improvements than the short-interval training method. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui pengaruh metode latihan drill dan short interval terhadap kemampuan renang gaya bebas 25 meter. Penelitian menggunakan metode eksperimen semu (quasi-experimental) dengan desain two-group pretest-posttest. Sampel penelitian terdiri atas 25 atlet Club Renang Banyu Pratama (BPC) yang dibagi menjadi dua kelompok, yaitu kelompok drill (10 atlet) dan kelompok short interval (10 atlet). Instrumen penelitian menggunakan tes renang gaya bebas 25 meter, sedangkan analisis data dilakukan menggunakan statistik deskriptif, uji normalitas shapiro–wilk, dan uji paired sample t-test. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa kedua metode latihan memberikan pengaruh yang signifikan terhadap kemampuan renang gaya bebas 25 meter (p < 0,05). Kelompok drill mengalami penurunan rata-rata waktu tempuh dari 19,88 detik menjadi 18,08 detik (peningkatan 1,82 detik), sedangkan kelompok short interval mengalami penurunan dari 19,88 detik menjadi 19,21 detik (peningkatan 0,66 detik). Dengan demikian, kedua metode latihan efektif meningkatkan kemampuan renang gaya bebas 25 meter, namun metode drill memberikan peningkatan yang lebih besar dibandingkan metode short interval.

title: Quantum-Inspired Reconfigurable Computing for Accelerated Matrix Computations in High-Performance Embedded Systems
abstractText: The emergence of data-hungry systems in the form of artificial intelligence, real-time signal processing, and scientific computing systems inside embedded systems has set extremely high requirements to the computational capabilities, electrical energy efficiency and flexibility. The computational backbone of many of these applications is matrix computations, that typically face bottlenecks in traditional processor architectures because of individual resources having no parallelism, and a lack of dynamism in resource allocation. In order to overcome such limitations, this paper introduces a new reconfigurable computing implementation, called Quantum-Inspired Matrix Engine (QIME) that emulates all three of these important quantum computing concepts of superposition, parallelism, and entanglement in a classical hardware setting. The system of the proposal will be applied to the Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs), and here, the system will be used to incorporate a pseudo-quantum state encoding process that enables the representation and processing of multiple matrix states simultaneously. QIME also has dynamic partial reconfiguration (DPR) so as to further have flexibility and efficiency in matching the architecture in real time with the nature and the complexity of the operations performed in the matrix. Also, there is approximate computing, where computational precision is traded off against performance where the tradeoff is allowed to increase energy profiles under workload variability. Experimental analysis of some typical benchmarks on matrices, including multiplication, decomposition, and convolution, shows that for representative operations QIME provides up to 6.3x speedup and 4.1x energy efficiency improvements over typical matrix co-processors and embedded GPUs. These findings will support the viability of quantum-inspired design paradigms in moving forward the performance and scalability of high-performance embedded systems, especially in the edge, and constrained circumstances where conventional quantum hardware is infeasible.

title: Internet of Things-Based Automatic Fish Feeding System Using ESP32 with Real-Time Monitoring
abstractText: Uncontrolled feeding can reduce the efficiency of fish farming. This study develops an Internet of Things-based automatic fish feeding system using ESP32, integrated with a load cell sensor, an ultrasonic sensor, and an RTC module for scheduled feed dispensing and real-time monitoring through the Blynk application. The test results showed that the ultrasonic sensor had an error of 0%, while the load cell had an average error of 5.61%. Operational testing over 14 days resulted in feed dispensing ranging from 206 to 219 g per session. Compared with the manual method, which had an average error of 48.9%, the automatic system provided more consistent and measurable feed portions. These results indicate that an IoT-based system can improve precision in feed management for fish farming

title: Digital Forensic Analysis of a Case of Pornographic Content Dissemination on WhatsApp Using the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Method
abstractText: The dissemination of pornographic content through instant messaging applications such as WhatsApp is becoming increasingly widespread. A major obstacle to establishing legal proof in these cases is that perpetrators frequently use the "Delete for Everyone" feature to eliminate digital evidence. This study aims to apply the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) method to obtain digital artifacts from messages deleted on the perpetrator's device. A simulated scenario was conducted between the victim's device (Xiaomi Redmi 10C) and the perpetrator's device (a rooted Xiaomi Redmi S2). The investigation used MOBILedit Forensic Express for physical acquisition and Belkasoft Evidence Center for data analysis. The results show that the NIST framework successfully overcame anti-forensic obstacles. The recovered digital evidence included metadata from 3 deleted text messages with logical deletion status, 3 image files containing pornographic content (.tmp/.jpeg), and 2 video files (.mp4). Cross-validation between fragments from the perpetrator's msgstore.db database and the victim's screenshots demonstrates that this method can produce legally valid and compelling electronic evidence for court proceedings.

title: Design and Development of An Iot-Based Digital Scale for Measuring Cement Weight Using A Load Cell Sensor at Pt Semen Tonasa, Balikpapan Branch
abstractText: Manual cement weighing in the industrial environment of PT Semen Tonasa, Balikpapan Branch, is considered inefficient and prone to human error. This study aims to develop a prototype Internet of Things-based digital conveyor weighing system capable of automatically measuring, sorting, and monitoring the weight of cement packages. The system is controlled by an ESP32 microcontroller integrated with a load cell sensor and an HX711 amplifier module to read the dynamic weight of packages moving on the conveyor. The conveyor belt is driven by a DC motor with a BTS7960-series driver, while a servo motor serves as the sorting arm actuator. The system is programmed to recognize a target cement weight of 500 grams with a tolerance of 10 grams. Remote monitoring is performed through a local web server dashboard with a client–server architecture that displays indicators and weighing history charts without excessively burdening the microcontroller memory. Test results show that the system successfully identifies peak loads dynamically, allows on-target packages to proceed, and automatically removes nonconforming packages. The device demonstrates very high accuracy, with an average reading error of only 0.63%. The system exhibits substantially better precision and operational consistency than conventional weighing methods

title: Internet of Things for Web-Based Heart Rate and Body Temperature Monitoring
abstractText: Independent health monitoring is important to support the early detection of changes in physical condition. This study aims to design an Internet of Things-based heart rate and body temperature monitoring system accessible through the web. The system uses an ESP32 microcontroller connected to a MAX30102 sensor to acquire heart rate data and an MLX90614 sensor to acquire body temperature data. The acquired data are transmitted over a WiFi network to a web server developed using the Django framework for storage and real-time display on a web dashboard. Testing was conducted by comparing sensor readings with an oximeter and a digital thermometer as reference instruments. The results showed that the MAX30102 sensor achieved an accuracy of 96.16% to 97.90%, while the MLX90614 sensor achieved an accuracy of 99.08% to 99.13%. In addition, black-box testing was used to evaluate the main functionalities of the web system, including real-time monitoring data display, graphical visualization, historical data, and data storage in the database. The results showed that all system features operated as designed, enabling the system to receive, store, and display monitoring data from the IoT device in an integrated manner through a web interface

title: Doktrin Keselamatan (Soteriologi): Unsur, Pandangan Teologis, dan Aplikasinya bagi Umat Kristen
abstractText: Soteriologi atau doktrin keselamatan merupakan doktrin inti iman Kristen, namun perdebatan tentang bagaimana keselamatan diterima masih menimbulkan kebingungan tentang hubungan antara anugerah Allah dan tanggung jawab manusia. Artikel ini mendeskripsikan pengertian dan dasar Alkitab soteriologi, unsur-unsur utamanya, pandangan teologis yang berkembang, serta aplikasinya dalam kehidupan umat Kristen masa kini. Dengan pendekatan kualitatif melalui studi kepustakaan dan analisis isi deskriptif, dikaji buku teologi sistematika dan artikel jurnal. Keselamatan ditemukan sebagai karya Allah melalui Yesus Kristus yang diterima melalui iman dan bersifat eksklusif di dalam Kristus, dengan lima unsur utama: anugerah, iman, pertobatan, pembenaran, dan pengudusan. Universalisme, Calvinisme, dan Arminianisme berbeda penekanan, tetapi ketiganya sepakat bahwa keselamatan hanya ada di dalam Yesus Kristus. Doktrin ini diaplikasikan dalam rasa syukur, kekudusan, pertobatan yang berkelanjutan, kasih, pengampunan, dan pengharapan.

title: Peran Motivasi dalam Memediasi Pengaruh Soft Skill terhadap Kesiapan Kerja Mahasiswa
abstractText: The increasingly competitive nature of the labor market requires university students not only to possess strong academic competencies but also to develop work readiness supported by soft skills and motivation. This study aims to examine the effect of soft skills on students’ work readiness, with motivation serving as an intervening variable among students of the Faculty of Economics and Business at Universitas Pembangunan Nasional “Veteran” Jawa Timur. This research employed a quantitative approach using primary data collected through an online questionnaire. The population of this study consisted of active students from the 2021 cohort of the Faculty of Economics and Business at UPN “Veteran” Jawa Timur, with a sample of 150 respondents. The data were analyzed using the Partial Least Squares (PLS) method with the assistance of SmartPLS software. The results indicate that soft skills have a positive and significant effect on motivation. Furthermore, motivation has a positive and significant effect on work readiness. Soft skills also have a direct, positive, and significant effect on work readiness. The analysis of the indirect effect further demonstrates that motivation significantly mediates the relationship between soft skills and work readiness. Based on these findings, it can be concluded that the development of soft skills and motivation are interconnected in supporting students’ readiness to face the demands of and enter the workforce. The study implies that higher education institutions can strengthen students’ preparation for employment by integrating activities that develop communication, critical thinking, collaboration, self-management, and career-oriented motivation.

title: Bifunctional Modulation of Nucleation and Phase Transformation by TFMBT for Efficient Carbon-Based CsPbI3– x Br x Perovskite Solar Cells
abstractText: Abstract All-inorganic CsPbI3–xBrx perovskites have emerged as promising photovoltaic materials owing to their excellent thermal stability and tunable bandgap. However, solution-processed CsPbI3–xBrx films continue to suffer from sluggish crystallization kinetics and poor phase stability, which severely limit device performance. Herein, we introduce 6-(trifluoromethyl)–2(3H)-benzothiazolethione (TFMBT) as a multifunctional additive to regulate nucleation and phase transformation. The N–H and C=S groups of TFMBT synergistically weaken the DMSO-[PbI6]4– coordination via hydrogen bonding and Lewis acid–base interactions, facilitating solvent removal and lowering the nucleation barrier. Meanwhile, the CF3 group engages the N–H group of DMA+ in N–H···F contacts, accelerating DMA+ deintercalation and Cs+ incorporation to expedite phase transformation. This synergistic effect cooperatively accelerates the crystallization kinetics, yielding high-quality films with enlarged, uniform grains and suppressed defects. Benefiting from the optimized crystallization regulation and improved film quality, the TFMBT-modified carbon-based CsPbI3–xBrx perovskite solar cells achieve a champion power conversion efficiency of 15.34%, significantly outperforming the control devices (12.75%), along with excellent stability.

Comparison of One-Dimensional and Quasi-Two-Dimensional Friction Models for Hydraulic Transient Response and Energy Dissipation in Viscoelastic Pipelines at Different Water Temperatures
abstractText: Abstract In chemical process systems, high-density polyethylene (HDPE) piping is widely used for conveying thermally conditioned liquids because of its corrosion resistance and operational flexibility; however, its pronounced viscoelastic response during hydraulic transients can strongly affect pressure regulation, process safety, and pipeline integrity, particularly under temperature-varying operating conditions. The temperature-dependent evolution of viscoelastic parameters, the differences between transient-flow models, and the associated energy-dissipation mechanisms remain insufficiently clarified for chemical engineering applications. In this study, transient-flow experiments in HDPE pipes at 20–40 °C were combined with numerical simulations using a one-dimensional quasi-steady friction model and a quasi-2D (quasi-two-dimensional) friction model. The first-peak occurrence time remained nearly constant at 0.1179 ± 0.0129 s, while the later response, particularly the third peak, was progressively delayed. The identified effective creep-compliance parameters increased overall with temperature and exhibited finite model-conditional admissible ranges. Model-based energy decomposition indicated that the calculated temperature-induced increase in total dissipation was governed primarily by the viscoelastic term WP, whereas the calculated frictional term Df varied comparatively little; the kinetic–elastic energy-exchange process also became shorter at elevated temperatures. The quasi-two-dimensional model did not yield a uniformly lower pressure-history RMSE, but its radial resolution of axial velocity and near-wall shear revealed model-dependent Df/WP partitions that became pronounced at 35–40 °C. These findings clarify the coupled effects of temperature and viscoelasticity on transient flow in polymer process pipelines and provide a mechanistic basis for model selection, pressure-surge control, and the safe operation of chemical-engineering piping systems.

title: HUBUNGAN ANTARA FORGIVENESS DENGAN RESILIENSI PADA REMAJA BROKEN HOME DI SULAWESI UTARA
abstractText: ABSTRACT Family fragmentation dynamics often require adolescents to redefine their psychological orientation amid the transition toward independence. Although parental separation triggers emotional disruption, adaptive capacity can still grow through the support of internal and external resources. This study aims to analyze the relationship between forgiveness and resilience among adolescents from broken home families in North Sulawesi. Employing a quantitative approach with a correlational design, this research involved 187 participants aged 13–18 years recruited through purposive sampling. The measuring instruments applied included the Heartland Forgiveness Scale and the Connor-Davidson Resilience Scale. Hypothesis testing was performed using Spearman Rank Order correlation because the data distribution violated the normality assumption. Empirical findings confirm a significant positive correlation at a moderate level (r_s = 0.444, p < 0.001), indicating that a higher capacity for forgiveness aligns with the reinforcement of adolescent mental endurance. Consequently, forgiveness deserves to be positioned as a relevant psychological modality in assisting adolescent survivors of divorce, while simultaneously enriching a multidimensional understanding of their adaptation process amidst a local socio-religious climate. ABSTRAK Dinamika keretakan keluarga kerap menuntut remaja mendefinisikan ulang orientasi psikologisnya di tengah transisi kemandirian. Kendati perpisahan orang tua memicu disrupsi emosional, kapasitas adaptasi tetap dapat bertumbuh melalui dukungan sumber daya internal maupun eksternal. Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis hubungan antara forgiveness dan resiliensi pada remaja dari keluarga broken home di Sulawesi Utara. Menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif berdesain korelasional, riset melibatkan 187 partisipan berusia 13–18 tahun yang direkrut melalui teknik purposive sampling. Perangkat ukur yang diaplikasikan mencakup Heartland Forgiveness Scale dan Connor-Davidson Resilience Scale. Pengujian hipotesis dijalankan melalui teknik korelasi Spearman Rank Order karena sebaran data melanggar asumsi normalitas. Temuan empiris mengonfirmasi keberadaan korelasi positif yang signifikan pada tingkat sedang (r_s = 0,444, p < 0,001), yang mengindikasikan bahwa kapasitas pemaafan yang lebih tinggi beriringan dengan penguatan daya tahan mental remaja. Dengan demikian, forgiveness layak diposisikan sebagai salah satu modalitas psikologis yang relevan dalam mendampingi remaja penyintas perceraian, sekaligus memperkaya pemahaman multidimensional mengenai proses adaptasi mereka di tengah iklim sosial-religius lokal.

title: In search of the original tepary bean, Phaseolus acutifolius Asa Gray (Leguminosae, Phaseoleae), in the Trans-Pecos Region of Texas
abstractText: This note presents the search for the type locality of the tepary bean, Phaseolus acutifolius. Two specimens kept in the herbaria of Harvard (GH00064068) and Kew (K000900693) were considered as lectotype and isolectotype, respectively. The field notes left by the collector Charles Wright and the analysis of the exploration conditions in October 1849 pointed to original collecting in the North Mountain of Hueco Tanks in El Paso County, Texas. During this study, the location was revisited in September 2025 and seed for germplasm conservation was collected. The role of the Texas Parks and Wildlife Department in saving a unique cultural and biological heritage is highlighted.

title: Aplikasi Absensi Berbasis Android untuk Optimalisasi Pengelolaan Kehadiran Petugas Kebun Desa Hameli Ate
abstractText: Attendance management for field-based garden workers requires a mechanism that integrates user identity, attendance time, and location in an accurate and easily monitored process. Manual attendance recording may cause delays in data recapitulation, difficulties in tracing attendance records, and limitations in validating employee locations. This study aims to develop an Android-based attendance application to optimize attendance management for garden workers in Hameli Ate Village. The system was developed using the Waterfall model, consisting of requirements analysis, system design, implementation, testing, and maintenance. Flutter was used as the frontend, Laravel as the backend API, MySQL as the database, and GPS/geolocation as the mechanism for validating workers’ positions based on predefined workplace coordinates and radius. The application provides login, check-in and check-out attendance, attendance history, leave and permission requests, monitoring, workplace location management, holiday management, and attendance reporting features. Functional testing was designed using Black Box Testing, while usability evaluation was planned using the System Usability Scale (SUS). The development results indicate that the system accommodates the main requirements of both workers and administrators and provides centralized attendance data management. However, actual testing data and SUS scores from real users were not yet available; therefore, the system’s quantitative success rate and usability level cannot yet be conclusively reported.

title: Moltkia and Other Octocorallia from the Eocene of North Carolina
abstractText: Three new species of octocorals were found in deposits of the Middle Eocene Castle Hayne Formation in North Carolina. The most common was a species of Moltkia Steenstrup, M. alveolata sp. nov. The genus Moltkia has long been thought to be a member of the Isididae but herein is shown to be a precious coral in the family Coralliidae, which are no longer extant in the western tropical Atlantic. Moltkia species have been found across Tethys to New Zealand during the Late Cretaceous to Eocene and are most closely related to the modern genus Pleurocorallium Gray found only in the western tropical Pacific. Two species of Ellisella are also described, along with several sclerites from unknown species of Paramuriceidae and Plexauridae. All three genera are found in shallow tropical reef areas of the world today.

title: Dynamic Clearance Strategies for Highly Perishable FMCG Products: A Stochastic Dual-Channel Approach for Cleaner Logistics and Supply Chain
abstractText: Abstract In the fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) industry, there are many difficulties in managing highly perishable products, resulting in high food waste and financial losses. In this study, the common “oversupply undersupply” problem of 120-hour shelf-life products have been explored and a dual channel “Near Food Channel” (NFC) clearance strategy is recommended. We develop a two-step simulation optimization approach. A Stochastic Mixed Integer Non-Linear Programming (SMINLP) model with Sample Average Approximation (SAA) is formulated in GAMS. This model computes the mathematically optimum Protection Level (PL). Since it is known that there are some limitations of the continuous models in capturing the discrete consumer behavior, these values were taken and fine-tuned using Discrete Event Simulation (DES) using Rockwell Arena 14.0 software. Empirical stochastic inputs like a Freshness Decay Penalty ( = max (0.1, N (0.72, 0.05))) and Price Elasticity ( = max (0.1, N (2.85, 0.05))) were incorporated to study the probability of fresh and clearance channel conversions. The results indicate a 100% Waste Mitigation Efficiency () for all tested inventory levels (1,700-3,000 units) when an aging inventory is being routed at a critical time (72 hours) using dynamic markdown strategies. This framework cuts down on physical waste, saves the profits of distributors (18,623 – 19,426 BDT profit compared to -11,300 BDT loss in conventional operations at =3000). Also, there is no wasted material left, so the typical 1-3% wastage allowance that manufacturers offer distributors is not needed. It's a win-win-win situation: reduced food waste, increased profits, and a healthier, more sustainable food supply chain.

abstractText: Abstract We have demonstrated an efficient Pd-catalyzed annulative dual C2–H/N–H arylation reaction involving modification of the tryptophan indole skeleton to phenanthridinyl indole. This is an operationally simple and ligand-free strategy that was extended to biologically important indole derivatives and tryptophan-containing short peptides to deliver a diverse unnatural phenanthridinyl indole-tethered peptide with good efficiency. Notably, the method demonstrated good tolerance for N- and C-terminal protecting groups as well as for the side-chain functionalities of other amino acids.

title: Boosting Iturin A Production in Bacillus velezensis by Multimodule Engineering, Operon Restructuring, and Pickering Emulsion Fermentation
abstractText: Abstract Iturin A is a valuable natural cyclic lipopeptide with broad application potential in multiple fields such as food preservation and agricultural production. However, its industrial production remains limited due to low fermentation yield. In this study, iturin A biosynthesis in Bacillus velezensis was enhanced by modifying the genes involved in fatty acid precursors, amino acid precursors, regulators, and transporters, such as accAD, serC, and comA. Additionally, insertion of a terminator–promoter regulatory element into the ituA–ituB intergenic region prevented upstream polar effects and reinitiated downstream transcription, which increased the transcript abundance and stability of the ituB–ituC region to further improve iturin A yield. Optimization of the N-terminal-coding sequence of ituD in the engineered strain ZD-F23 further elevated iturin A yield to 3.85 g/L in shake flasks, representing a 7.95-fold increase over the wild strain ZD122 (0.43 g/L). Finally, iturin A yield was increased to 4.59 g/L in shake flasks by coupling microbial fermentation with Pickering emulsion techniques in an optimized oil-in-water system. This value represented the highest iturin A titer among previous B. velezensis strains. In summary, this study establishes a multilevel engineering strategy integrating transcriptional reprogramming with emulsion-based fermentation, demonstrating the potential for scalable biomanufacturing of iturin A.

title: Peran Jaksa Pengacara Negara dalam Proses Penegakan Hukum Terhadap Anak Korban Pemerkosaan Bapak Kandung di Kejaksaan Negeri Way Kanan
abstractText: The rape of a child by her biological father constitutes a form of intrafamilial sexual violence (incest) that causes severe physical, psychological, and social consequences for the victim. Law enforcement in such cases should not merely focus on punishing the perpetrator but must also ensure the protection and restoration of the victim's rights. This study aims to analyze the role of the State Attorney (Jaksa Pengacara Negara) in the law enforcement process concerning child victims of rape committed by their biological fathers at the Way Kanan District Prosecutor's Office and to examine the factors affecting the implementation of that role. This research employed an empirical juridical approach through field research supported by library research using a descriptive qualitative method. Primary data were obtained through interviews and document analysis, while secondary data were collected from court decisions, statutory regulations, and relevant legal literature. The findings reveal that the State Attorney plays a strategic role in supporting legal protection for child victims by providing legal assistance, legal opinions, other legal actions, and inter-agency coordination to ensure the fulfillment of victims' rights, including legal assistance, rehabilitation, identity protection, and restitution. An analysis of Court Decisions Number 4/Pid.Sus/2025/PN Bbu, Number 12/Pid.Sus/2025/PN Bbu, Number 47/Pid.Sus/2025/PN Bbu, and Number 126/Pid.Sus/2025/PN Bbu demonstrates that all cases involved the abuse of parental authority by biological fathers or stepfathers against their children. The study also finds that the effectiveness of the State Attorney's role is influenced by supporting factors, including comprehensive child protection legislation, the commitment of law enforcement officers, and effective inter-agency cooperation, as well as inhibiting factors such as victims' psychological trauma, limited evidence, inadequate family awareness of victims' rights, insufficient professional support personnel, and geographical constraints within Way Kanan Regency. Therefore, strengthening inter-agency coordination and optimizing victim protection mechanisms are essential to achieving a more effective child protection system based on the principle of the best interests of the child.

title: PENGARUH HEAT INDEX TERHADAP DEPLESI, PBBH, DAN BOBOT BADAN AYAM BROILER YANG DIPELIHARA PADA KANDANG SERAYU FARM 2
abstractText: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis pengaruh heat index terhadap deplesi, pertambahan bobot badan harian (PBBH), dan bobot badan ayam broiler yang dipelihara pada lantai kandang berbeda di Kandang Serayu Farm 2. Penelitian dilakukan menggunakan metode observasi pada sistem kandang closed house dengan ayam broiler berstrain Ross. Populasi ayam broiler yang digunakan sebanyak 20.910 ekor dengan 28 unit pengamatan pada lantai 2 dan 28 unit pengamatan pada lantai 3. Parameter yang diamati meliputi heat index, deplesi, pertambahan bobot badan harian, dan bobot badan ayam broiler. Data dianalisis menggunakan uji Independent Sample t-test pada taraf signifikansi 5 persen. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa nilai heat index pada lantai 2 secara nyata lebih tinggi dibandingkan lantai 3. Perbedaan nilai heat index tersebut tidak memberikan pengaruh yang nyata terhadap deplesi, pertambahan bobot badan harian, dan bobot badan ayam broiler. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa perbedaan kondisi mikroklimat kandang memengaruhi nilai heat index, tetapi belum berdampak signifikan terhadap performa produksi ayam broiler. Manajemen pemeliharaan dan pengendalian mikroklimat kandang yang baik mampu menjaga performa ayam broiler tetap berada dalam batas toleransi fisiologis meskipun terjadi perbedaan heat index antar lantai kandang.

PERAN BUMDes DALAM PEMBERDAYAAN EKONOMI PETANI STUDI KASUS DI DESA NGERU KECAMATAN MOYO HILIR KABUPATEN SUMBAWA
abstractText: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis peran Badan Usaha Milik Desa (BUMDes) dalam pemberdayaan ekonomi petani di Desa Ngeru, Kecamatan Moyo Hilir, Kabupaten Sumbawa. Penelitian dilaksanakan pada bulan April–Mei 2026 menggunakan pendekatan deskriptif kualitatif. Penentuan informan dilakukan secara purposive sampling, yang terdiri atas Kepala Desa, perangkat desa, pengurus BUMDes, ketua kelompok tani, dan petani penerima layanan simpan pinjam BUMDes. Teknik pengumpulan data meliputi observasi, wawancara, kuesioner, dan dokumentasi. Analisis data menggunakan model Miles dan Huberman yang meliputi reduksi data, penyajian data, serta penarikan kesimpulan, sedangkan persepsi petani dianalisis menggunakan skala Likert. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa dari empat aspek peran BUMDes yang diteliti, hanya aspek fasilitas permodalan yang berada pada kategori baik dengan total skor 17,7. Sementara itu, aspek penyediaan sarana produksi pertanian memperoleh skor 9,36 dengan kategori tidak baik, aspek pengelolaan dan pemasaran hasil pertanian memperoleh skor 8,2 dengan kategori sangat tidak baik, dan aspek penguatan kapasitas serta kelembagaan petani memperoleh skor 9,2 dengan kategori tidak baik. Hal ini menunjukkan bahwa BUMDes Desa Ngeru masih berfokus pada kegiatan simpan pinjam dan belum menjalankan fungsi pemberdayaan ekonomi petani secara menyeluruh. Kedepanya, BUMDes perlu mengembangkan unit usaha pada bidang penyediaan sarana produksi, pemasaran hasil pertanian, serta pelatihan dan pendampingan petani agar perannya dalam meningkatkan kesejahteraan masyarakat desa dapat berjalan lebih optimal.

title: What are people saying about DoxyPEP? A topic-based analysis of Reddit discussions
abstractText: Background Doxycycline post-exposure prophylaxis (DoxyPEP) is a strategy for bacterial STIs prevention; however, despite strong evidence from clinical trials that DoxyPEP reduces the incidence of syphilis and chlamydia, its real-world uptake is shaped by public perception. In this study, we aim to examine how DoxyPEP is discussed in online communities and identify dominant themes that may influence its implementation. Methods We applied an unsupervised text analysis approach (BERTopic) to identify interpretable themes from a large corpus of Reddit posts discussing DoxyPEP posted between November 2020 and May 2025, and subsequently conducted expert-informed interpretation to refine the thematic structure. Results We identified 8139 posts for topic modelling, of which 5296 were assigned to interpretable topics. Discussions encompassed prevention strategies, sexual practices, antimicrobial resistance and healthcare access. Notably, conversations extended beyond men who have sex with men contexts to include heterosexual, polyamorous and swinger communities, where DoxyPEP was discussed as part of broader risk management practices. Rather than simple misinformation, posts reflected active negotiation of evolving biomedical evidence and personal risk. Access to LGBTIQA+-friendly clinicians and telehealth services facilitated uptake, whereas provider knowledge gaps acted as barriers. Conclusion Online community-generated discourse provides insight into how STIs prevention strategies and interventions are interpreted in practice, particularly around risk assessment, access to appropriate care and concerns about antimicrobial resistance. Clearer, consistent clinical guidance and information-sharing by community-level organisations may help support informed and equitable DoxyPEP implementation and better sexual health education.

title: Studi Eksperimental Sifat Mekanik dan Ketahanan Api Hybrid Composite Serat Ijuk (Arenga Pinnata) dengan Variasi Fraksi Volume
abstractText: The development of natural fiber-based composite materials is an alternative approach for producing lightweight and economical materials while supporting the utilization of agricultural waste. This study aims to analyze the effect of sugar palm fiber (Arenga pinnata) volume fraction and alkaline treatment on the mechanical properties and burning resistance of epoxy matrix composites. The sugar palm fibers were treated using 5% NaOH solution for 2 hours and incorporated into the composite at volume fractions of 10%, 20%, 30%, 40%, and 50%. The composites were fabricated using the hand lay-up method. Mechanical characterization included tensile testing according to ASTM D638 and flexural testing according to ASTM D790, while burning resistance was evaluated according to ASTM D635. The results showed that increasing the fiber fraction tended to improve the tensile strength. The highest tensile strength was obtained at a 50% fiber fraction without treatment, reaching 52 MPa. Meanwhile, the highest Modulus of Rupture (MoR) was obtained at a 50% fiber fraction with alkaline treatment, reaching 55.66 MPa. In the burning test, the lowest burning rate was obtained at a 50% fiber fraction, with values of 17.55 mm/min for untreated specimens and 17.78 mm/min for treated specimens. The results indicate that a 50% fiber fraction provides the best overall mechanical performance, while the effect of alkaline treatment on tensile strength and burning resistance does not show a consistent trend across all fiber fractions.

title: STEM Educational Approach in Secondary EducatiAn Interdisciplinary Application for Cardiovascular Health
abstractText: The STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics) educational approach constitutes an innovative pedagogical model that promotes interdisciplinary learning, 21st-century skills development, and the application of theoretical knowledge to real-world problems. This study presents the implementation of a STEM-based learning activity in a first-year upper secondary school class, aimed at designing an algorithm for assessing cardiovascular health by integrating biological, nutritional, emotional, social, and environmental parameters. The activity was designed to foster critical thinking, collaboration, and interdisciplinary understanding. Its impact was evaluated through a comparison with a control group taught the same topics using traditional instructional methods. Results indicate that the STEM approach led to higher levels of engagement, skill development, and conceptual comprehension.Finally, a mathematical model is proposed in which learning (L) is defined as a function of three key parameters: conceptual understanding , skills , and collaboration . This modeling framework offers a basis for the systematic assessment and design of STEM interventions in secondary education.

title: Peran Strategi Coping dalam Mengendalikan Kecemasan untuk Mendukung Performa Atlet Anggar Pekanbaru Fencing Club
abstractText: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis peran coping strategy dalam mengendalikan kecemasan untuk mendukung performa atlet anggar di Pekanbaru Fencing Club. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan metode quasi experiment melalui desain Nonequivalent Control Group Design. Sampel penelitian berjumlah 10 atlet yang dibagi menjadi kelompok eksperimen dan kelompok kontrol. Instrumen penelitian menggunakan angket kecemasan bertanding yang diberikan pada saat pre-test dan post-test. Analisis data dilakukan menggunakan uji Paired Sample t-test dan Independent Sample t-test. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa kelompok eksperimen mengalami penurunan rata-rata kecemasan bertanding dari 72,60 menjadi 42,80 setelah diberikan coping strategy. Hasil Independent Sample t-test menunjukkan nilai signifikansi sebesar 0,001 (p < 0,05), yang menunjukkan adanya perbedaan signifikan antara kelompok eksperimen dan kelompok kontrol. Dengan demikian, coping strategy berperan efektif dalam menurunkan kecemasan bertanding dan mendukung kesiapan mental atlet anggar.

title: Paintable In Situ Gelling Bioelectronic Interfaces for Epidermal Electrophysiological Monitoring
abstractText: Abstract Noninvasive epidermal electrophysiological monitoring is frequently constrained by unstable electrode-skin contact interfaces over soft, textured, and dynamically deforming skin. The predefined geometries of conventional electrodes limit their capacity to conform to local microtopography. Here, we introduce an in situ gelation strategy performed directly on the epidermis to construct a conformal ionic bioelectronic interface. A fluidic precursor comprising gelatin and tannic acid is initially stabilized against premature gelation via competitive solvent–solute interactions. Upon application, solvent evaporation and gelatin reassembly induce rapid network formation. This process directly yields a highly conformal and gently detachable interface with remarkably low contact impedance. The resulting hydrated dynamic network provides mechanical compliance, robust interfacial adhesion, stretch-tolerant ionic conduction, and cooling-induced interfacial weakening that enables gentle removal. The on-skin-gelled interface reduces skin–electrode contact impedance to 30 kΩ at 10 Hz, compared with 191 kΩ for commercial conductive pastes, and increases the signal-to-noise ratio from 24.9 to 27.8 dB. In proof-of-concept demonstrations, the interface supports within-subject electromyography-based gesture recognition with a classification accuracy of 93.4% and electroencephalography recordings of eye-state-dependent α-rhythm modulation as well as short-term sleep-related waveforms. These findings underscore the potential of on-skin in situ gelation as a versatile approach to fabricating paintable ionic bioelectronic interfaces for advanced electrophysiological monitoring.

Trypethelium flavopigmentosum (lichenized Ascomycota: Trypetheliaceae), a new lichen species from Mt. Palhi, Dinagat Islands, Philippines
abstractText: During our continued expeditions in the Dinagat Islands, southern Philippines, a new species, Trypethelium flavopigmentosum Taer & Aptroot, was discovered and is herein described. It closely resembles T. luteolucidum in the thallus and pseudostromata reacting UV+ yellow, the presence of lichexanthone, and the inspersed hamathecium. However, T. flavopigmentosum is distinguished by its prominent yellow pigment at the surface of the pseudostromata, inside with an additional yellow dusty granular pigment, and a smaller, 9–10-septate ascospore, 41–61 × 9–13 μm. This discovery represents the first documented lichen species from Mt. Palhi, and further emphasizes the exceptional biodiversity supported by the ultramafic forest ecosystems. Given increasing anthropogenic pressures, these findings underscore the urgent need for legislative protection and strengthened conservation management of the Dinagat Islands.

title: One-Handed and Two-Handed Backhand and Tennis Elbow Prevalence in Adult Tennis Players
abstractText: Tennis elbow, or lateral epicondylalgia, is a common musculoskeletal condition among tennis players; however, the association between backhand technique and symptom prevalence remains uncertain. This study examined whether one-handed (1HB) and two-handed (2HB) backhand techniques were associated with clinically assessed tennis elbow in adult tennis players. A cross-sectional study included 48 participants: 23 1HB players and 25 2HB players. Demographic characteristics, weekly training volume, and years of tennis participation were recorded. The primary outcome, defined as dominant-arm elbow pain (DEP), required the presence of lateral elbow pain, tenderness over the lateral epicondyle, and pain reproduced by resisted wrist extension or resisted middle-finger extension. Between-group comparisons were performed using independent-samples t tests, chi-square tests, and Mann–Whitney U tests, as appropriate. The mean age was 41.8 ± 17.0 years, and 72.9% of participants were male. The 1HB group was older than the 2HB group (49.9 ± 17.2 vs. 34.3 ± 13.0 years, p < 0.001) and consisted exclusively of male participants (100% vs. 48.0%, p < 0.001). The median weekly training volume was 6 hours in both groups (p = 0.757). The prevalence of DEP was 47.8% among 1HB players and 52.0% among 2HB players (χ² = 0.08, p = 0.777). No statistically significant association between backhand technique and DEP was identified in this sample. However, the analysis was unadjusted, and the substantial imbalance in age and sex between groups precluded interpretation of the findings as evidence of an independent association between backhand technique and tennis elbow. The results also did not establish equivalence between the two techniques. Larger prospective studies with adjustment for demographic and training-related confounders and standardized clinical assessments are needed before backhand technique can be used to inform injury-prevention recommendations.

The Relationship Between Social Media Use and Sleep Quality Among Adolescents at SMAN 1, Kota Ternate
abstractText: Social media has become an integral part of adolescents' daily lives, with increasing engagement through digital devices, particularly during nighttime hours, potentially affecting sleep quality. This study aimed to examine the association between social media use and sleep quality among adolescents at Sekolah Menengah Atas Negeri (SMAN) 1 Kota Ternate, Indonesia. A quantitative analytical observational study with a cross-sectional design was conducted involving 289 students selected through proportional cluster sampling. Data were collected using the Social Media Use Scale and the Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI). Descriptive and bivariate analyses were performed using SPSS statistical software, with the chi-square test employed to assess the association between social media use and sleep quality. Of the 289 respondents, 229 (79.2%) demonstrated moderate social media use, 49 (17.0%) demonstrated high social media use, and 11 (3.8%) demonstrated low social media use. Regarding sleep quality, 204 respondents (70.6%) were classified as having poor sleep quality, while 85 (29.4%) were classified as having good sleep quality. The chi-square test revealed a statistically significant association between social media use and sleep quality (p = 0.022). These findings indicated that social media use was significantly associated with sleep quality among adolescents at SMAN 1 Kota Ternate. However, the cross-sectional design did not establish a causal relationship between these variables. The results highlighted the importance of promoting responsible social media use, particularly before bedtime, and encouraging healthy sleep practices among adolescents.

abstractText: This study aimed to formulate and solve an optimal control problem for a nonlinear differential equation model to minimize the cumulative burden of misconceptions and the quadratic cost of intervention. The state variables represent the proportions of learners with insufficient understanding, misconceptions, and conceptual understanding. The time-dependent control regulated the transition from misconceptions to conceptual understanding, with an upper intensity bound of 0.30 over a horizon of 100 time units. The necessary conditions for optimality were derived using Pontryagin’s minimum principle. The numerical solution was obtained by reducing the model from three to two dimensions and applying the forward-backward sweep method based on fourth-order Runge–Kutta integration with damping. For the assumed parameter values α = 0.20, β = 0.75, γ = 0.15, δ = 0.10, and baseline weights A = B = 1, the optimal control yielded an objective value of 2.7064, lower than those obtained under the no-control scenario and constant controls of 0.10 and 0.20. The cumulative burden of misconceptions was 1.5492, with a control energy of 2.3143. Compared with the constant control of 0.20, the optimal strategy reduced the cumulative burden of misconceptions by 26.1% and used 42.1% less energy. The control intensity remained near its upper bound until time 9.50, then gradually decreased to zero at the terminal time. Numerical verification yielded a maximum mass conservation error of 2.55 × 10⁻¹⁵, a state difference of 2.00 × 10⁻¹⁵ between the two- and three-dimensional models, and a projection residual of 8.66 × 10⁻⁹. Sensitivity analysis at B = 0.5, 1, 2, and 5 showed a consistent trade-off between intervention cost and the persistence of misconceptions. This study provides a mathematical framework for examining time-dependent conceptual interventions. Because all parameters and cost weights are assumed, the findings are limited to the model’s mathematical implications and cannot be treated as empirical recommendations.

title: Optimasi Stok dan Pengelolaan Penjualan dengan Sistem Berbasis Web Menggunakan Metode Economic Order Quantity
abstractText: Hasibuan Collection is a retail business operating five branches in Padang Sidempuan, Panyabungan, and Sibuhuan. Inventory and sales were previously managed manually, causing recording delays, inconsistent stock data across branches, and difficulties in preparing accurate and timely reports. This study aims to design and implement a web-based information system integrating the Economic Order Quantity (EOQ) method to determine economical order quantities and centralize stock and sales management. The study applies an applied-research approach and the Waterfall model of the System Development Life Cycle. Primary data were obtained through observation, interviews, documentation, and operational records from March 2025 to March 2026. The system was implemented with Node.js and Express.js on the backend, Vue.js on the frontend, and MongoDB as the database. EOQ calculations produced optimal order quantities of 9,943, 3,018, 4,292, 5,979, and 11,571 units for the five branches, respectively. Annual holding and ordering costs were nearly balanced at the optimum point. Black-box testing of 14 scenarios showed that all tested functions operated successfully. The integrated system therefore supports centralized, data-driven inventory control and improves operational efficiency and decision accuracy.

The Concept of Teacher Personality in Islamic Education: Exploring Qur’anic Principles and Prophetic Guidance
abstractText: Teacher personality influences students’ character, moral values, and spiritual development, extending educators’ responsibilities beyond knowledge transmission. In Islamic education, these responsibilities require the integration of professional competence with ethical and religious commitments. This study examines teacher personality from an Islamic perspective grounded in Qur’anic values and Hadith teachings, focusing on Islamic personality concepts, teacher roles, and moral characteristics. A qualitative library research approach was employed, using content analysis of primary sources comprising Qur’anic verses and Hadith and secondary sources comprising Islamic educational literature and relevant academic studies. The findings indicate that Islamic teacher personality integrates intellectual understanding, spiritual awareness, and moral conduct. The concepts of ‘aqliyah and nafsiyah represent Islamic thinking and behavioral orientations, respectively. Teachers’ responsibilities are articulated through their roles as murabbi (nurturer), mu‘allim (knowledge provider), and mu’addib (character builder). Essential characteristics include sincerity (ikhlas), trustworthiness (amanah), patience (sabr), compassion (rahmah), and exemplary conduct (uswah hasanah). Together, these findings position moral integrity and spiritual responsibility as integral dimensions of teacher professionalism alongside teaching competence. The study provides a conceptual basis for developing teacher personality through Qur’anic and Prophetic guidance, highlighting its relevance to meaningful and holistic educational practice.

title: Cytoplasmic C-Terminal Domain of the MmpL11 Lipid Transporter Is Required for Interaction with Its Co-cistronic Partner MSMEG_0240 in Mycobacterium smegmatis
abstractText: Abstract MmpL proteins play an important role in the various mechanisms associated with mycobacterial virulence. Identification of interacting protein partners by classical in vitro methods is hampered by the low solubility of these integral membrane proteins. In this study, we used two independent biotin proximity labelling assays (APEX2 and BioID) to define the proxisome of MmpL11 in Mycobacterium smegmatis. Crucially, these techniques are performed directly in the organism of interest, allowing the detection of potentially transient or weak interactions in multiprotein complexes and preserving the subcellular structures and the presence of cofactors or post-translational modifications that can also impact protein–protein interactions. BioID leads to the biotinylation of lysine residues, whereas APEX2 leads to the biotinylation of mainly tyrosine residues; they have also been shown to have different effective labelling radii. On one hand, an interaction was detected between the cytoplasmic C-terminal domain of MmpL11 and MSMEG_0240, a protein of unknown function, using BioID. This interaction was confirmed using both MmpL11 and MSMEG_0240 as fusions with BirA and was further supported by AlphaFold3 prediction. On the other hand, APEX2 did not detect proximity between MmpL11 and MSMEG_0240, probably due to the absence of accessible tyrosines. However, both approaches identified MSMEG_0940 as an additional interactant with MmpL11 that also depends on its C-terminal domain. Overall, this study demonstrates the utility of APEX2 and BioID as complementary tools for defining the proxisome of mycobacterial proteins.

title: Rekonstruksi Obstruction of Justice atas Manipulasi Adversarial Bukti Elektronik Berbasis AI dalam KUHP dan KUHAP Indonesia
abstractText: The development of artificial intelligence has transformed criminal evidence, particularly when electronic evidence is not merely falsified but adversarially manipulated to deceive AI-based analytical systems. This study aims to reconstruct the concept of obstruction of justice concerning adversarial manipulation of electronic evidence within Indonesia’s Criminal Code and Criminal Procedure Code. It employs normative legal research using statutory, conceptual, case, and comparative approaches. The findings show that adversarial manipulation differs from conventional digital falsification because attacks may target an AI system’s inference process without significantly altering the visible appearance of evidence. Normatively, Article 278 of the Criminal Code has the strongest connection to direct manipulation of evidence, while Articles 281 and 282 may only apply when their specific elements are satisfied. In procedural law, electronic evidence authentication should be supplemented by assessment of analytical reliability, including model transparency, error rates, reproducibility, and adversarial robustness. This study proposes the Adversarial Evidence Interference Test, consisting of judicial-process nexus, adversarial act, knowledge and purpose, material interference capability, and forensic causal traceability. This reconstruction enables criminal law to adapt to AI developments without expanding criminalization by analogy and strengthens protection for the integrity of criminal evidentiary processes. It promotes accountable, transparent, and reviewable digital adjudication. Keywords: Obstruction of justice; Adversarial manipulation; Electronic evidence; Artificial intelligence; Criminal evidence.

title: Tetrapyridophenazine-Based Vinylene-Linked Covalent Organic Frameworks for Efficient Sequential Photocatalysis and Continuous-Flow Synthesis
abstractText: Abstract Vinylene-linked covalent organic frameworks (COFs) are promising photocatalysts because their conjugated sp2-carbon frameworks combine exceptional chemical stability with efficient charge transport. However, the limited reversibility of C═C bond formation narrows the scope of polymerizable monomers, restricting the structural diversity and electronic tunability of vinylene-linked COFs. Here, we report a molecular design strategy based on a planar, electron-deficient, nitrogen-rich tetrapyridophenazine (TTPhz) building block for constructing vinylene-linked COFs. Knoevenagel polycondensation of a polymerizable TTPhz monomer with aromatic dialdehydes affords three highly crystalline COFs with tunable donor–acceptor interactions and electronic structures. The optimized fluorinated framework, TTPhz-COF-3, exhibits efficient charge separation and transport, enabling a previously unreported one-pot sequential photocatalytic synthesis of 2,3-dihydrobenzofuran derivatives from arylboronic acids through tandem aerobic hydroxylation and oxidative [3 + 2] cycloaddition. The catalyst displays broad substrate scope, excellent recyclability, and enables gram-scale continuous-flow synthesis of a key intermediate of the natural product (±)-conocarpan with a 4-fold higher turnover frequency than the corresponding batch process. This work expands the structural and functional scope of vinylene-linked COFs and establishes molecular building-block design as a general strategy for developing advanced crystalline organic photocatalysts.

title: Driving Individual Taxpayer Compliance in the Coretax Era: The Mediating Power of Internal Motivation
abstractText: This study examined the effects of the Coretax System, tax regulations, and tax sanctions on individual taxpayer compliance, with internal motivation serving as an intervening variable. A quantitative survey was conducted among 80 individual taxpayers in Sidoarjo Regency, Indonesia, selected through purposive sampling. Data were collected through questionnaires and analyzed using partial least squares structural equation modeling with SmartPLS 4.0. The Coretax System, tax regulations, tax sanctions, and internal motivation each had positive and significant effects on individual taxpayer compliance. Internal motivation also significantly mediated the effects of the three external variables on compliance, indicating partial mediation. Taxpayer compliance emerged from the interplay between external instruments, including digital administration, regulation, and enforcement, and the internal psychological forces that sustain voluntary compliance. The study was limited to 80 respondents in one regency and relied on cross-sectional perceptions collected at a single point in time. The study extends the tax compliance literature by demonstrating the mediating role of internal motivation and offers practical guidance for the Directorate General of Taxes in refining Coretax implementation, regulatory design, and sanction policies.

Leadership Style and Perceived Meritocracy: Work Engagement as a Mediator of Job Satisfaction
abstractText: The management of non-organic workers requires organizations to pay attention not only to supervisory practices but also to the fairness and objectivity of employment-related decisions. This study examines the effects of leadership style and perceived meritocracy on job satisfaction, with work engagement serving as a mediating variable among non-organic workers at PT Petrokopindo Cipta Selaras. The study employed a quantitative explanatory design and analyzed data from 100 respondents using Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) with SmartPLS 4. The measurement model consisted of 16 indicators representing leadership style, perceived meritocracy, work engagement, and job satisfaction. The results show that leadership style does not significantly affect either work engagement (β = -0.023, p = 0.891) or job satisfaction (β = 0.126, p = 0.303). In contrast, perceived meritocracy has a positive and significant effect on work engagement (β = 0.706, p < 0.001) and job satisfaction (β = 0.323; p = 0.032). Work engagement also positively affects job satisfaction (β = 0.439, p = 0.001). The mediation analysis further indicates that work engagement does not mediate the relationship between leadership style and job satisfaction, whereas it significantly mediates the relationship between perceived meritocracy and job satisfaction (β = 0.310, p = 0.003). These findings highlight the importance of merit-based workforce management in strengthening work engagement and job satisfaction among non-organic workers.

abstractText: This Community Service Program (KKN) aims to improve the digital financial literacy of Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) in Dewi Sri Village by providing an understanding of the functions, benefits, and use of the Quick Response Code Indonesian Standard (QRIS) as a digital payment method. This program also seeks to enhance the ability of MSME owners to register for, create, and implement QRIS in their daily business transactions. The program was implemented through educational sessions, presentations on the benefits of digital payments, interactive discussions, and direct assistance in the QRIS registration and implementation process. This study employed a descriptive qualitative approach, with data collected through observation, interviews, and documentation to obtain a comprehensive understanding of the program's implementation and impact. The results indicate that educational activities and direct assistance helped improve MSME owners' understanding of digital payment systems, particularly QRIS, while providing practical experience in its registration and use. Furthermore, this program encouraged MSME owners to adapt to rapidly evolving financial technologies. QRIS implementation is expected to improve transaction efficiency, facilitate convenient payments for consumers, and support more modern business management practices. Overall, this KKN program contributes positively to improving digital financial literacy, strengthening MSME competitiveness, and accelerating the sustainable digital transformation of payment systems in Dewi Sri Village.

title: The correlation between primary education teachers’ tacit knowledge and their teaching self-efficacy.
abstractText: This study investigates the relationship between primary education teachers’ tacit knowledge and their teaching self-efficacy. Tacit knowledge, as a product of professional experience that integrates skills, values, and intuitive judgments, is associated with the improvement of teaching practice and the enhancement of school effectiveness. At the same time, self-efficacy influences the willingness to utilize and share knowledge, highlighting a bidirectional relationship between the two factors. Overall, their interaction contributes to strengthening teaching effectiveness and promoting educational innovation within the school environment.

title: Decoding Tunable Ring-Specific Adaptive Aromaticity in 1,3-Diaza-5,6-Diborabicyclo[3.1.0]hexatriene: Insights from a Combined DFT and Machine Learning Study
abstractText: Aromaticity, a cornerstone of chemical stability, is governed by Hückel’s and Baird’s rules for the ground $(S_0)$ and triplet excited $(T_1)$ states, respectively, yet these canonical rules are challenged by two-state aromaticity (adaptive aromaticity)—a burgeoning frontier in aromaticity research. Herein, density functional theory (DFT) investigations reveal that 1,3-diaza-5,6-diborabicyclo[3.1.0]hexatriene (1) and its all-carbon congener both exhibit $S_0$ entire-fused system aromaticity, but show striking $T_1$ divergence: the carbon analog loses aromaticity entirely, while compound 1 displays ring-specific adaptive aromaticity (5MR antiaromatic, 3MR aromatic). Nitroso/nitro substituents act as potent spin modulators, enabling switching between localized and whole-system $T_1$ aromaticity. A multiple linear regression model identifies spin localization and charge distribution as the principal contributors to $T_1$-state electron delocalization within the present dataset, while an Extreme Learning Machine (ELM) classifier reproduces the DFT-derived aromaticity categories with 93% accuracy on the held-out entry-level test set. This combined DFT–ML strategy provides a complementary data-driven framework for analyzing adaptive aromaticity in BN-doped heterocyclic systems.

Novel Modifications ΔI127/L85R in FsSdhD Are Involved in Differential Resistance to Pydiflumetofen in Fusarium solani
abstractText: Abstract Lentil root rot (LRR), caused by the soil-borne fungal pathogen Fusarium solani, severely threatens lentil production. Pydiflumetofen (Pyd), a succinate dehydrogenase inhibitor (SDHI) fungicide, is applied to manage diseases caused by Fusarium spp. In this study, the frequency distribution of 50% inhibitory concentration (EC50) of F. solani to Pyd was established, and the mean EC50 value was 0.089 ± 0.0080 μg/mL. A total of 12 Pyd-resistant (PydR) mutants were generated through Pyd-taming, and the resistance frequency was 0.6%. Sequence analysis identified that distinct amino acid substitutions, A85 V in FsSdhC2 or L85R, ΔI127, and D128N in FsSdhD, were associated with moderate to high levels of Pyd resistance. Molecular docking indicated that all mutations significantly reduced the binding affinity between Pyd and the FsSdh complex. These findings advance our mechanistic understanding of SDHI resistance and provide scientific directions for controlling LRR using Pyd.

title: Study on the Occurrence of Polycyclic Aromatic Hydrocarbons in Vehicular Soot and Outdoor Dust Samples: Concentrations, Profiles, and Source Estimation
abstractText: Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) are pollutants of global concern due to their omnipresence in the environment and their negative effects on ecosystems and human health. Investigations on the occurrence of PAHs in emission sources and related environmental compartments are essential to understanding the behavior and fate of these pollutants. In this study, concentrations of 17 PAHs were analyzed in vehicular soot and outdoor dust samples collected from northern Vietnam. The samples were processed using ultrasound-assisted extraction and solid-phase extraction techniques. PAH concentrations were determined using a gas chromatography/mass spectrometry (GC/MS) method with internal standard quantification. Concentrations of 17 PAHs decreased in the order of gasoline soot (median 844,000; range 380,000–2,336,000 ng/g) > diesel soot (8500; 7200–176,000 ng/g) > outdoor dust (410; 130–2100 ng/g). The most predominant compounds were pyrene, benzo[ghi]perylene, fluoranthene, benzo[b+j]fluoranthene, and phenanthrene. Several PAH molecular indices in soot and dust samples were calculated and compared. Vehicular exhausts are important sources of PAHs in urban outdoor dusts. Our results have confirmed the pyrogenic origins of PAHs and the possibility of using molecular indices in PAH source apportionment. Further studies should be performed to characterize source-to-sink profiles of PAHs and related compounds in Vietnam.

Program “Ayo Cek Ginjal!”: Pemeriksaan Ureum dan Kreatinin untuk Masyarakat Beresiko Tinggi di Desa Sokaraja Kidul
abstractText: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is a progressive health problem that may remain asymptomatic during its early stages, making early detection among high-risk populations essential. The “Ayo Cek Ginjal!” community service program aimed to improve kidney health knowledge among community members and health cadres, identify individuals at risk of impaired kidney function, and encourage appropriate follow-up for abnormal screening results. The program was implemented in Sokaraja Kidul Village through health cadre training, community education, risk-factor assessment, blood pressure, body weight, and body mass index measurements, and urea and creatinine testing using point-of-care testing (POCT). Health cadres and the community service team provided result-based education, follow-up assistance, and referral for participants requiring further evaluation. Kidney health education reached 100 community members, while screening was conducted among 45 individuals at risk. The results showed that 33 participants (73.3%) were within the reference range, 5 (11.1%) were classified as high risk, 2 (4.4%) as very high risk, and 5 (11.1%) had creatinine levels below the reference range. Two participants with markedly elevated results were referred for further evaluation at healthcare facilities. The program demonstrates that integrating health education, cadre participation, risk-based screening, POCT, and referral mechanisms can support improved kidney health literacy and early detection of impaired kidney function at the community level.

title: “MY WASTE MY RESPONSIBILITY”: EARLY EDUCATION TO IMPROVE ELEMENTARY SCHOOL STUDENT’S KNOWLEDGE OF WASTE REDUCTION
abstractText: ABSTRACT Waste management in primary educational institutions demands a proactive orientation that extends beyond sorting and final disposal, focusing instead on efforts to prevent waste generation right at its source. This community service initiative aims to enhance the knowledge of students at SDN Tunggulsari 02 Surakarta regarding waste reduction through an educational and participatory approach, while simultaneously providing an applicable activity model to strengthen the environmental culture within the implementation of the Adiwiyata Program. The activity, involving 136 pupils from grades 1 to 6, was carried out through a series of interactive stages encompassing socialization, educational games, video screenings, and reflective discussions. Knowledge evaluation combined structured oral assessments for grades 1 to 2 with standardized multiple-choice questionnaires for grades 3 to 6, ensuring that the baseline group outcomes were not directly compared with the older student cohorts. Accumulative results recorded an increase in the mean pre-test score from 65.41 to 73.70 on the post-test, representing an improvement of 8.29 points. Inferentially, the mean score for grades 3 to 4 increased from 1.72 to 2.15 (p = 0.001), while grades 5 to 6 rose from 2.44 to 3.29 (p < 0.001). These data confirm that multisensory learning methods effectively strengthen students' cognitive capacity to identify waste prevention measures at the source. This program provides a relevant preliminary foundation to support the continuous development of a sustainable, environmentally conscious culture within the school. Revisiting Alpinia cumingii (Zingiberaceae): phylogenetic placement, recircumscription and a description of a new morphologically similar species
abstractText: Alpinia cumingii was described by Karl Moritz Schumann from the Philippines in 1904. Two remarkably similar species, also from the Philippines, Alpinia penduliflora and Alpinia pendula, were described respectively in 1909 by Henry Nicholas Ridley and 1928 by Eduardo Quisumbing and Elmer Drew Merrill, without any reference to A. cumingii, and placed in different sections of Alpinia. A fourth morphologically similar species was collected in New Guinea during fieldwork in 2008. Using molecular data, we aim to determine the phylogenetic relationships of the four species and integrate morphological data to assess the rank at which these should be recognised. We collected new material close to the three type localities in the Philippines and used these new collections as a basis for an updated morphological description, including the previously undescribed species from New Guinea. Molecular analyses revealed that all four species grouped within the Alpinia eubractea clade both in the internal transcribed spacer (ITS) and trnK–matK regions with strong support. The undescribed species from New Guinea appeared as a sister taxon to the Philippine species in the ITS tree, whereas using the trnK–matK region, it grouped with Vanoverberghia, both with weak support. We name the species Alpinia oktediensis, referring to the type locality. Our data support A. pendula as a distinct species, whereas A. cumingii and A. penduliflora are considered conspecific. We also report a collection from Karekelong Island, as evidence for a new record of A. cumingii in the flora of Indonesia. We provide provisional conservation assessments for each species.

title: Increasing abundance of nitrogen-fixing Trichodesmium in Australian waters
abstractText: Context The filamentous cyanobacteria, genus Trichodesmium, is a marine diazotroph that converts atmospheric nitrogen into more bioavailable forms and is therefore important in nutrient cycling in oligotrophic marine ecosystems. Aims This study aimed to confirm findings from historical field observations, remote sensing, laboratory experiments, and models that Trichodesmium may become increasingly important under climate change. Methods We used Tweedie models with a 16-year time series of Trichodesmium observations in Australian waters, based on samples collected with bottles, nets, and the Continuous Plankton Recorder (for microscopic analysis) and environmental DNA from filtered water. Key results The highest Trichodesmium abundances were found in tropical regions, primarily in response to warmer temperatures. However, Trichodesmium is found in lower abundances throughout Australian waters. There are two species common in Australian waters, T. thiebautii dominating on the eastern coast and T. erythraeum on the west, each with slightly different thermal niches. Conclusion Trichodesmium abundance has increased in Australia since 2009. This trend is expected to persist as warming continues, strengthening stratification and reducing the upward mixing of nitrate. Implications This study has deepened our understanding of Trichodesmium in Australian waters, underscoring the importance of ongoing observations as the extent of ocean suitable for Trichodesmium growth increases.
