title: Diagnosing Regional Contrasts in May-to-June Surface Ozone Transitions across China
abstractText: Abstract Ground-level ozone (O3) is a major warm-season air-quality challenge in China, decreasing from May to June in southern China but increasing in North China (NC). Yet the distributional basis of this contrast remains unclear. Using 2015–2025 observations, reanalysis, fire data, and backward trajectories, we partitioned the May-minus-June change (ΔO3) in monthly mean maximum daily 8 h average (MDA8) O3 into contributions from high-O3-day frequency, high-O3-day intensity, and the nonhigh-O3-day component. Mean ΔO3 was +8.16 ppb in Southeast China (SEC), +5.55 ppb in Southwest China (SWC), and −6.10 ppb in NC. The frequency contribution was the largest component and closely tracked interannual ΔO3 (r = 0.92–0.98). Stronger SEC transitions were associated with a dry, strongly irradiated May followed by a wetter June, whereas stronger NC transitions coincided with warmer, sunnier, less cloudy, and drier June conditions. Western SWC showed a larger decrease than eastern SWC (11.25 versus 3.42 ppb) under comparatively dry conditions and potential exposure to biomass-burning-influenced air masses from mainland Southeast Asia; eastern SWC instead showed June moistening and reduced radiation. These results clarify how the regional contrast is statistically expressed and identify the distinct atmospheric environments associated with its interannual variability.

Phospholipase Fluorogenic Probes and Molecular Determinants of Cyclic Guanosine Monophosphate–Adenosine Monophosphate Binding to Cyclic Oligonucleotide-Based Antiphage Signaling System CapV
abstractText: Abstract Cyclic oligonucleotide-based antiphage signaling systems (CBASS) protect bacteria from bacteriophage infection by producing cyclic nucleotide second messengers that activate downstream effector proteins. Cyclic guanosine monophosphate–adenosine monophosphate (cGAMP)-activated phospholipase in Vibrio (CapV) is a prevalent CBASS effector whose activity is commonly monitored using the commercially available fluorogenic substrate resorufin butyrate; however, this probe is hydrolyzed by both basal and activated CapV, limiting its usefulness in CapV-related studies. Here, we report the rational design and evaluation of a series of resorufin ester probes with varying acyl chain lengths to improve the fluorogenic assay used to monitor CapV (from Acinetobacter baumannii and Vibrio cholerae) activation. While resorufin butyrate and pentanoate exhibited substantial cGAMP-independent hydrolysis, resorufin octanoate and decanoate provided an optimal balance between catalytic turnover and activation-dependent discrimination, displaying over 5-fold and approximately 10-fold increases in hydrolysis, respectively, upon 3′,3′-cGAMP activation. Using resorufin octanoate as a fluorogenic reporter, we systematically investigated the effects of cyclic dinucleotide structural modifications on CapV activation. Phosphorothioate analogues with nonbridging sulfur (exo-S linkages) retained partial agonist activity, whereas the corresponding bridging 5′-phosphorothioester (endo-S) analogues was inactive, highlighting the importance of the native phosphodiester moiety in activating CapV. Replacement of the ribose 2′-hydroxyl groups with fluorine preserved CapV activation, whereas 2′-deoxy substitutions reduced activity, with modifications on the adenosine moiety having a greater detrimental effect than those on guanosine. These findings using the fluorogenic probes were validated using phospholipid hydrolysis and activity-based protein labeling assays. Molecular docking and 100 ns molecular dynamics simulations revealed that the observed activity trends arise from differential disruption of key hydrogen-bonding interactions and ligand conformations required for productive CapV activation. Together, these fluorogenic probes provide a robust, high-throughput-compatible platform for studying CapV activation and defining cyclic dinucleotide structure–activity relationships.

title: IDENTIFIKASI FAKTOR-FAKTOR YANG MEMPENGARUHI PENETAPAN HARGA GABAH TERHADAP KESEJAHTERAAN PETANI DI KECAMATAN PLAMPANG, KABUPATEN SUMBAWA
abstractText: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengidentifikasi faktor-faktor apa saja yang mempengaruhi penetapan harga gabah di Desa Plampang, Kecamatan Plampang, Kabupaten Sumbawa. Penelitian dilaksanakan pada bulan Mei sampai dengan Juli 2026. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif. Data yang digunakan yaitu data primer dan data sekunder. Pengumpulan data melalui survei, wawancara, serta dokumentasi. Penentuan responden dilakukan secara sengaja (purposive sampling) dari masing-masing dusun yaitu berjumlah 42 petani. Alat analisis yang digunakan dalam penelitian ini adalah analisis Miles and Hubberman. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa penetapan harga gabah di Desa Plampang dipengaruhi oleh peran pedagang atau tengkulak, kondisi permintaan dan penawaran pasar, kualitas gabah, biaya produksi, serta kondisi musim dan cuaca. Faktor yang paling dominan adalah ketergantungan petani terhadap pedagang atau tengkulak akibat keterbatasan informasi harga, modal, fasilitas penyimpanan, dan alternatif pemasaran, sehingga posisi tawar petani relatif rendah.

title: Optimalisasi Pengolahan Limbah Tempurung Kelapa melalui Penguatan Produksi, Manajemen Keuangan, dan Pemasaran di Kota Kupang
abstractText: Coconut shell waste is one of the local resources with potential to be developed into economically valuable products, one of which is charcoal as a raw material for briquettes. East Nusa Tenggara Province has considerable potential for raw materials, with coconut production reaching 64,320 tons in 2022, 64,922 tons in 2023, and 61,122 tons in 2024. However, this potential has not yet fully generated added economic value for the community. This community service activity aimed to increase community empowerment through strengthening production capacity, business and financial management, and marketing. The implementation method employed Focus Group Discussions (FGD), Participatory Action Research (PAR), training and mentoring, evaluation, and program sustainability planning. The results showed that mentoring in the financial management aspect improved partners’ understanding of transaction recording, production cost identification, calculation of Cost of Goods Manufactured (COGM), determination of selling prices, and profit management. In the marketing aspect, partners gained knowledge of promotional strategies, product identity, the use of digital media, and market expansion. Overall, the activity improved partners’ basic knowledge and skills and provided a foundation for developing a more organized, effective, independent, and sustainable business.

title: Early post-operative outcomes in very young infant patients after off-pump periventricular hybrid surgery vs. on-pump traditional cardiopulmonary bypass
abstractText: Background: Traditionally ventricular septal defects (VSDs) are corrected via open-heart surgery under cardiopulmonary bypass (CPB), which involves prolonged anesthesia and increases the risk of neurological complications in very young children. In the present retrospective study, we compare early post-operative outcomes of traditional CPB versus a periventricular hybrid surgery (PHS) for VSD correction in infants aged ≤1 year. Methods: The patients were divided into the PHS cohort (n=181) and the CPB cohort (n=189), treated between 2016 and 2024 at a single center. Results: The hybrid approach significantly reduced the duration of anesthesia, mechanical ventilation, intensive care unit (ICU) stay, and in-hospital stay. The post-operative left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) was significantly higher while its change vs. pre-operative level was significantly lower in the PHS vs. CPB cohort. Only 21% of PHS patients required inotropic support, compared to 95.8% of CPB patients. Notably, the CPB cohort exhibited a significantly higher incidence of early post-operative transient neurological disorders vs. the PHS cohort (46.0% vs. 8.3%). We identified age as well as weight, height, and body surface area as risk factors for neurological complications in both surgical cohorts, regardless the type of a neurological complication. Additionally, we revealed lowered intraoperative arterial pressure and elevated post-operative LVEF as independent risk factors. Conclusions: The hybrid VSD correction is a highly effective and safer alternative to traditional open-heart surgery for infants. It significantly minimizes early post-operative morbidities, reduces recovery times, and dramatically lowers the incidence of transient brain ischemia that can result in various neurological disorders.

title: Digital Footprints and Student Privacy: The Role of Educators Under the GDPR
abstractText: The General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), which came into effect in 2018, establishes a uniform legal framework for the processing of personal data within the European Union. The Regulation also applies to the education sector, imposing strict requirements for the management of student and staff data. Although its implementation is accompanied by challenges—such as a lack of awareness, insufficient training, and the complexity of the legal framework—it also offers opportunities to strengthen privacy protection and create a safe educational environment. Best practices, such as incorporating the principles of the GDPR into digital teaching, collaborating with stakeholders, and training staff, are considered essential for schools to effectively comply with the Regulation.

abstractText: 本研究以创意家具制为实践项目，围绕新时代学生劳动素养的发展需求，探究该项目与创造性劳动培育的内在联系，构建“技能筑基—创意赋能—实践育人”的实践路径。研究表明，以瓦楞纸等环保材料开展项目化家具制作，能够推动学生手脑协同、自主探究、迭代优化，有效提升实践操作、创新设计与问题解决能力。结合课堂实施情况，提出分层适配教学、过程化指导、综合性评价三项优化策略，为小学创造性劳动课程落地提供可借鉴的实践方案。

title: Phenylalanine Fibrils Seed Native Lysozyme to Form Membrane-Active Pathological Complexes at Physiological Conditions
abstractText: Abstract Accumulation of metabolites at pathological concentrations can trigger nonclassical protein aggregation pathways that remain poorly understood. Here, we explore the molecular mechanism by which the metabolite phenylalanine (Phe), known to form amyloid-like fibrils in Phenylketonuria disease, induces a globular protein to form complex structures. We demonstrate that Phe fibrils act as molecular scaffolds to promote aggregation of a stable globular protein lysozyme (Lyz) under physiological conditions (pH 7.4, 37 °C), resulting in the formation of a heteronuclear Lyz–Phe complex. Spectroscopic and biophysical analyses reveal that π–π interactions between Trp residues of Lyz and the aromatic surface of Phe fibrils drive the initial association; additional hydrophobic interactions stabilize the complex. Unlike classical amyloidogenesis dominated by β-sheet enrichment in proteins, this heteronuclear complexation induces a substantial increment of random coil content in the protein’s secondary structure with only a modest increase in the β-sheet content. The resulting complex strongly interacts with phospholipid bilayer membranes, compromises the membrane integrity, and exhibits significant cytotoxicity toward cultured mammalian fibroblast cells (L929). This study offers a hitherto unexplored alternative aggregation mechanism in which a metabolite imbalance, rather than intrinsic protein instability, converts a native globular protein into membrane-active, cytotoxic assemblies.

Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis peran guru AIK dalam membentuk karakter peserta didik di SMA Muhammadiyah 01 Pekajangan serta mengidentifikasi faktor pendukung dan penghambatnya. Data primer diperoleh melalui wawancara dengan kepala sekolah, lima guru AIK, dan ketua organisasi Hizbul Wathan pada September hingga Oktober 2026, sedangkan data sekunder berasal dari modul ajar, rencana pelaksanaan pembelajaran, dan dokumentasi kegiatan. title: Linking Active Madden–Julian Oscillation to High–Very High Rainfall During Large-Scale Flood Events in Banten and Jakarta
abstractText: The modulation of rainfall extremes by the Madden–Julian Oscillation (MJO) over Indonesia and the Maritime Continent is well established, but less is known about how consistently this relationship is represented in documented large-scale flood-impact records. This study provides an event-based assessment of active MJO phases 3–5 on high–very high (HVH) rainfall associated with large-scale flood events across seasonal rainfall zones (ZOMs). Flood records from 2008–2024 were linked with reconstructed daily rainfall data from 107 rain-gauge stations and daily Real-time Multivariate MJO index information. Large-scale flood events were defined based on spatial and temporal extent, while HVH rainfall was classified as rainfall above the 75th percentile and evaluated using maximum one-day and five-day accumulated rainfall. The results show that 210 of 577 HVH rainfall-event records, or 36.4%, occurred during active MJO phases 3–5. Active-MJO conditions occurred in 22.2% of one-day HVH rainfall events and 48.6% of five-day accumulated HVH rainfall events. During DJF, active MJO phases 3–5 occurred in 55.1% of five-day accumulated HVH flood-associated events, compared with a seasonal five-day-window baseline of 47.6%, corresponding to a modest enrichment ratio of 1.16. These findings indicate that active MJO phases 3–5 provide complementary information on multi-day HVH rainfall accumulation, although their contribution varies substantially by season and should be interpreted relative to the seasonal background occurrence of the MJO.

title: Rekonstruksi Mekanisme Penilaian Noodweer Exces Pada Tahap Pra-Adjudikasi Melalui Gelar Perkara Kolaboratif Dalam Mewujudkan Kepastian Hukum
abstractText: Noodweer exces merupakan alasan pemaaf terhadap pembelaan terpaksa yang melampaui batas akibat keguncangan jiwa yang hebat karena serangan atau ancaman serangan seketika yang melawan hukum. Penelitian ini menganalisis kedudukannya pada tahap pra-adjudikasi dan merekonstruksi gelar perkara kolaboratif sebagai mekanisme penilaian awal. Penelitian menggunakan metode hukum normatif dengan pendekatan perundang-undangan, konseptual, dan kasus serta analisis kualitatif-preskriptif. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa indikator noodweer exces harus diperiksa sejak penyidikan karena unsur serangan, pembelaan, pelampauan batas, kondisi psikologis, dan hubungan kausal bersumber dari fakta peristiwa. Penyidik tidak berwenang menentukan secara final terpenuhinya alasan pemaaf, tetapi wajib membangun konstruksi perkara secara objektif. Penelitian merekonstruksi gelar perkara kolaboratif sebagai legal quality control melalui integrasi penyidik, pengawas, fungsi hukum, penuntut umum, dan ahli sesuai kewenangannya. Model ini menekankan deteksi, pengujian, dan dokumentasi indikator noodweer exces sebelum arah akhir penyidikan ditentukan tanpa mengurangi independensi pengadilan dalam menetapkan pertanggungjawaban pidana.

title: Aberrant one-carbon metabolism and ancestral genetics underlie edematous severe acute malnutrition
abstractText: Abstract Edematous severe childhood malnutrition is distinct from the non-edematous form of malnutrition and remains a major cause of under-five mortality. Its etiology remains unclear, although aberrant one-carbon metabolism has emerged as a potential contributor. Here, we assess genetic variants at loci known to influence one-carbon metabolism, and determine their association with edematous malnutrition in Jamaica and Malawi. Six loci show evidence of association, including four related to homocysteine and folate metabolism - AHCYL1 , PRICKLE2 , GABBR2 , and PLD2 , with SNPs at the latter three also having direct effects on homocysteine-related metabolites in Mendelian Randomization. Collectively, one-carbon metabolism-related variants were significantly associated with edematous malnutrition (z = 3.2), with population differences linked to a shared East African genetic ancestry and distinct signatures of selection. These findings strengthen evidence implicating aberrant one-carbon metabolism in edematous malnutrition and highlight the utility of cell-free DNA, intra-continental admixture, and population genetics for mapping disease risk.

title: Pengaruh Influencer Marketing dan Brand Image serta Promosi Terhadap Keputusan Pembelian Skincare Somethinc di Samarinda
abstractText: This study aims to examine the effect of influencer marketing, brand image, and promotion on purchase decisions for Somethinc skincare in Samarinda. The study employed a quantitative approach with purposive sampling and involved 112 Somethinc skincare users in Samarinda. Data were collected through an online questionnaire (Google Form) using a 5-point Likert scale and analyzed using multiple linear regression with IBM SPSS Statistics 25. The analysis produced the equation Y = 1.470 + 0.522X1 + 0.364X2 + 0.233X3. The F-test showed that the three variables simultaneously have a significant effect on purchase decisions (F-count = 40.629; sig. = 0.000). Partially, influencer marketing (sig. = 0.000), brand image (sig. = 0.002), and promotion (sig. = 0.016) have a positive and significant effect on purchase decisions, with influencer marketing as the most dominant variable. The R Square value of 0.530 indicates that 53.0% of the variation in purchase decisions is explained by the three variables, while the remaining 47.0% is explained by other variables outside the model.

title: Hubungan panjang tungkai dan daya ledak otot tungkai dengan kemampuan lompat jauh gaya jongkok
abstractText: Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis hubungan panjang tungkai dan daya ledak otot tungkai, baik secara individual maupun simultan, dengan kemampuan lompat jauh gaya jongkok pada peserta didik laki-laki kelas VII SMP Negeri 6 Kota Malang. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan desain korelasional. Sebanyak 42 peserta didik laki-laki dengan usia rata-rata 13 tahun berpartisipasi dalam penelitian ini melalui teknik purposive proportional systematic random sampling. Panjang tungkai diukur menggunakan pita ukur (cm), daya ledak otot tungkai dinilai melalui tes lompat jauh tanpa awalan (standing long jump), dan kemampuan lompat jauh gaya jongkok diukur berdasarkan jarak lompatan (m). Data dianalisis menggunakan korelasi Pearson dan regresi linear berganda dengan bantuan IBM SPSS Statistics versi 27 pada taraf signifikansi α = 0,05. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa panjang tungkai (r = 0,733; p < 0,001) dan daya ledak otot tungkai (r = 0,771; p < 0,001) memiliki hubungan positif dan signifikan dengan kemampuan lompat jauh gaya jongkok. Secara simultan, kedua variabel menjelaskan 65,8% variasi kemampuan lompat jauh gaya jongkok (R = 0,811; R² = 0,658; p < 0,001). Berdasarkan perhitungan sumbangan efektif yang dilaporkan, panjang tungkai menyumbang 26,8%, sedangkan daya ledak otot tungkai menyumbang 38,9%. Dengan demikian, kedua variabel berkaitan dengan kemampuan lompat jauh gaya jongkok, dengan daya ledak otot tungkai menunjukkan sumbangan efektif yang lebih besar dalam model penelitian.

title: Cyperus flavicomus (Cyperaceae), long misnamed C. macrostachyos: a comprehensive taxonomic reassessment with annotated synonymy and voucher-backed global distribution
abstractText: The pantropical annual flatsedge widely known as Cyperus macrostachyos Lam. (Cyperaceae; Cyperus subg. Cyperus, former segregate genus Pycreus) has been described under no fewer than 30 names over the past two centuries, variously treated as one or two species, with no substantive consensus on circumscription or nomenclature. In North America, the species is instead recognized as C. flavicomus Michx. To resolve these discrepancies, we examined the protologues and, where available, original type material for all names currently or historically synonymized with C. macrostachyos s.l., supplemented by an extensive survey of digitized collections ascribed to the species and of broader Pycreus material from Africa and South Asia (ca. 2,000 specimens from 130 herbaria in total). We report three principal findings. First, the morphological variation historically used to separate the species into two taxa is attributable to characters that are either environmentally plastic or maturity-dependent, and does not warrant recognition of more than one species. Second, examination of the holotype and holotype fragment of C. macrostachyos reveals that the material is not conspecific with the pantropical species to which it has been applied since Hooper and Raynal (1969), but corresponds in all observable characters to the South Asian endemic C. puncticulatus Vahl. The “Ex Africa” locality cited by Lamarck (1791) could not be corroborated by any material among the extensive African collections surveyed; we render the type citation as “Uncertain locality (‘Ex Africa’ teste Lamarck 1791)” to reflect this. Third, the correct name for the pantropical species is C. flavicomus Michx. (1803)—first reinstated by Tucker (1985), here independently confirmed and extended to encompass the full synonymy. Conservation of C. puncticulatus Vahl against C. macrostachyos Lam. is recommended under Art. 14 of the ICN; a formal proposal will be submitted to Taxon. An annotated synonymy, revised description, and voucher-backed global distribution for C. flavicomus Michx. and lectotype designations for eleven names are provided.

title: A Thermoelectric Hydrogel-Based Insole with Self-Decoupled Temperature and Pressure Sensing for Diabetic Plantar Monitoring
abstractText: Abstract Plantar temperature and pressure reflect the plantar health status of diabetic patients and serve as critical indicators for evaluating disease progression. However, existing plantar monitoring devices are still limited by single-modal signal acquisition, bulky device configurations, and a strong reliance on external power supplies. Herein, we report a thermogalvanic hydrogel-based smart insole integrating self-powered sensing units for self-decoupled plantar monitoring. The insole integrates 16 self-decoupled thermogalvanic hydrogel sensing units, which convert plantar temperature difference and pressure stimuli into decouplable electrical signals via the thermogalvanic effect and the active iontronic piezoresistive effect, respectively. The incorporation of the backend acquisition circuit into the smart monitoring insole enables remote plantar temperature-difference and pressure mapping. Cloud-based machine learning further empowers the insole to assess plantar status in diabetic patients and distinguish disease-associated gait patterns. This work provides a versatile strategy for developing multimodal intelligent wearable platforms for personalized foot health monitoring and disease management.

title: Pendampingan Pendidikan Keagamaan melalui Penyuluhan Adab, Fikih Remaja, dan Tahsin Al-Qur’an di Dusun Sidomulyo
abstractText: Introduction: Religious education plays a key role in shaping well-rounded character intellectually, morally, and spiritually. Challenges such as low awareness of adab and limited understanding of practical fiqh, particularly regarding adolescent aurat, prompted the implementation of the Community Service Program (KKN) in Dusun Sidomulyo, Mendiro Village, Ngawi, East Java. Involving 10 sixth-semester students of Universitas Darussalam Gontor (UNIDA Gontor). Objective: The program aimed to strengthen family-and community-based religious education through several integrated activities. Method: These included counseling sessions for PKK mothers on the importance of adab in family life and child development, youth fiqh seminars focusing on the boundaries of aurat and appropriate Islamic practices, as well as mentoring activities through TPA and Tahsin Qiroah Qur’an. The program employed dialogical lectures, interactive seminars, question-and-answer sessions, discussions, demonstrations, and participatory mentoring to encourage active involvement among community members. Conducted over a period spanning 10 days before Ramadan and 20 days during Ramadan, the activities created opportunities for participants to apply religious knowledge in their daily lives. Result: The results indicated increased parental awareness of the importance of religious and ethical guidance, improved adolescent understanding of aurat boundaries, and enhanced quality of Qur’anic recitation among TPA participants. Conclusion: Overall, the program contributed to strengthening family and community capacity in religious education and fostering a more supportive religious environment in Dusun Sidomulyo.

title: Donor Atom and Spin-State Effects on Coordination of At$^{+}$ with Homodonor and Mixed N/O Crown-Type Macrocycles: a Computational Study
abstractText: Astatine-211, an $\alpha$-emitting radionuclide featuring near-quantitative $\alpha$ emission, has attracted significant interest for targeted alpha therapy. Beyond conventional radiolabeling strategies that exploit the halogen character of astatine, coordination-based approaches that utilize its metallicity represent a promising alternative. However, the coordination chemistry of At$^{+}$, particularly with macrocyclic ligands, remains largely unexplored. Herein, we systematically investigate the coordination of At$^{+}$ with a series of crown-type macrocycles, including homodonor all-nitrogen azacrowns, all-oxygen crown ethers, all-sulfur thiacrowns, and mixed N/O heterodonor diazacrown and tetraazacrown, using spin-orbit density functional theory (SO-DFT) in combination with scalar relativistic coupled-cluster approach with single, double and perturbative triple excitation (SR-CCSD(T)). The results show that all ligands considered form stable complexes with At$^{+}$. The coordination number and dominant spin multiplicity of the complexes are governed by the cavity size and donor atom type. Among the three categories of homodonor macrocycles, all-nitrogen azacrowns display the strongest overall binding affinity for At$^{+}$. Notably, the mixed N/O heterodonor ligand diaza-18-crown-6 (da18c6), which provides primary coordination through a pair of nitrogen donors and secondary coordination from four oxygen donors, yields the most stable complex. This work advances the understanding of At$^{+}$ coordination chemistry and provides insights into the rational design of chelators for At$^{+}$-based radiolabeling.

title: Beyond the gradient: local divergence and environmental interactions jointly shape testis mass in a widespread frog (Pelophylax ridibundus)
abstractText: Abstract Understanding intraspecific variation in reproductive investment is essential for explaining how populations respond to environmental heterogeneity. In amphibians, reproductive effort, measured as testis mass (TM), may be shaped by both individual condition and environmental context, yet their relative contributions remain unclear. We examined the relationships among body condition (BC), environmental gradients, and TM across 11 populations of the marsh frog, Pelophylax ridibundus , in Iran. Using morphological data from 205 adult males and a hierarchical framework, we found that BC was the strongest predictor of TM, supporting a condition-dependent reproductive strategy. However, this relationship varied among populations, which could be grouped into two subgroups differing in baseline TM and in the slope of the BC-TM relationship. Broad-scale climatic variables showed no direct effects on TM after accounting for population structure. Instead, environmental gradients modulated the BC-TM relationship: the positive effect of BC on TM weakened with increasing elevation but strengthened under warmer thermal conditions, whereas annual rainfall had no detectable influence. Linear mixed models outperformed non-hierarchical models, highlighting the importance of population-level structure. Our findings reveal hidden intraspecific heterogeneity in reproductive allocation and caution against relying on ecogeographical expectations when interpreting adaptive responses across environmental gradients.

title: THE INFLUENCE OF LEARNING ATMOSPHERE, PEER INTERACTION, AND FACILITATOR COMPETENCE ON PARTICIPANT SATISFACTION IN ENGLISH CLUB PROGRAMS
abstractText: This study investigates what drives participant satisfaction in community-based English training programs. The English Club Program serves as the research context, designed as an interactive platform to improve English communication skills among university students. Beyond instructional content, program quality is shaped by the learning atmosphere, peer interaction, and facilitator competence. This study therefore examines the influence of these three factors on participant satisfaction. Findings from 169 respondents show that all three contribute positively to satisfaction, with facilitator competence emerging as the strongest predictor. These results underscore the importance of building a supportive and interactive learning environment, guided by competent facilitators, to improve the overall quality of English language training programs.

abstractText: Virechana Karma is one of the important Shodhana therapies described in Ayurveda. It is mainly indicated in diseases caused by the predominance of Pitta and Rakta Dosha. In Ayurveda, various skin disorders are broadly described under the concept of Kushta. Skin is considered an important indicator of overall health, and healthy skin reflects a balanced state of the body. Improper dietary habits, unhealthy lifestyle, and faulty daily activities can disturb the balance of Doshas and may contribute to the development of diseases. Virechana is the second procedure among the five Panchakarma therapies and is especially useful for disorders involving Pitta and Rakta. It can also be beneficial when Pitta is associated with Vata or Kapha. According to Ayurveda, impairment of Agni and improper functioning of the liver along with Dosha imbalance may play a role in the development of skin disorders. Many chronic skin conditions may not respond adequately to conventional treatment, particularly when they are recurrent or difficult to manage. Virechana Karma helps eliminate aggravated Doshas from the body and may support the restoration of normal physiological balance. It has been described as useful in the management of various skin disorders such as psoriasis, eczema, acne vulgaris, vitiligo, and leukoderma. Ayurveda focuses on correcting the underlying imbalance rather than treating only the symptoms. This article reviews the role of Virechana Karma in the management of different skin disorders and discusses its possible benefits as an Ayurvedic purification therapy.

title: Agglomeration-Induced Deactivation of Metal Oxide-Based Catalysts by Dissolved Organic Matter in Heterogeneous Fenton Systems
abstractText: Abstract Heterogeneous Fenton processes are promising for wastewater treatment, yet their performance often deteriorates in dissolved organic matter (DOM)-rich waters. DOM inhibition has conventionally been attributed to reactive-species scavenging and active-site coverage. Here, we identify DOM-induced catalyst agglomeration as an additional deactivation pathway in metal oxide-based heterogeneous Fenton systems. DOM adsorbs onto catalyst surfaces through complexation, alters surface charge, and weakens interparticle electrostatic repulsion, thereby promoting rapid agglomeration and reducing the accessible catalytic surface area. At 30 mgC L–1 DOM, pH 4.0, and 25 °C, the hydrodynamic diameter of ferrihydrite increased from ∼220 nm to over 1300 nm, accompanied by a decrease in specific surface area from 118.1 to 62.8 m2 g–1. Similar DOM-induced inhibition was observed across six metal oxide catalysts, different DOM types, and real water matrices. Immobilizing ferrihydrite on a porous carbon substrate effectively suppressed particle migration and agglomeration, which enabled stable catalytic performance for over 30 h during continuous-flow treatment of landfill leachate. These findings extend the conventional understanding of DOM inhibition from chemical interference to catalyst-state destabilization and highlight particle stability as an important criterion for designing heterogeneous Fenton catalysts for practical water treatment.

Teacher Evaluation and Professional Development: Exploring the Experiences of Primary Education Teachers
abstractText: This paper explores kindergarten teachers’ perceptions of teacher evaluation, with a particular focus on its role as a process of reflection and professional development. The study adopted a qualitative research approach and was based on a focus group interview with kindergarten teachers who had participated in the evaluation process. The data were analyzed using thematic analysis, which identified the main dimensions of the phenomenon under investigation. The findings showed that participants initially experienced feelings of anxiety, uncertainty, and apprehension. However, the development of trusting relationships, the provision of feedback, and the implementation of supportive practices contributed to more positive perceptions of the evaluation process. At the same time, the findings indicated that evaluation promotes reflective practice, contributes to the improvement of teaching practices, and supports teachers’ continuous professional development. Finally, the study highlighted the need to adopt a more formative and collaborative model of evaluation that can respond more effectively to the needs of teachers and the wider school community.

title: A Reverse Supply Chain Model For Smartphone E-Waste Management in Bangladesh: Proposing A Closed-loop Framework
abstractText: Abstract Bangladesh has a lot of people who use phones over 180 million subscribers according to the Bangladesh Telecommunication Regulatory Commission in 2024. On average people replace their handsets every 2-3 years. There is no system in place to collect, process or get value from old smartphones. Existing research (Marufuzzaman et al., 2022) showed that the environmental laws in Bangladesh like the Environmental Conservation Act of 1995 the National Environmental Policy of 1992 and the Medical Waste Management Regulations of 2008 are not good enough for dealing with smartphones. These laws have been used informally for electronics. They do not work well. This paper looks at the problem from an angle as a supply chain management issue. It says that laws alone are not enough we need a system to collect take apart and recover value from phones. This study is based on the idea of an economy that focuses on collecting old phone materials processing them and reusing them instead of throwing them away. We used concepts from closed-loop supply chain theory and the Extended Producer Responsibility model. We also used data from the Bangladesh Telecommunication Regulatory Commission and other sources. We studied how old smartphones are being handled today. We found that if the amount of e-waste, from smartphones keeps growing it could create opportunities in Bangladesh. We made a forecast model that uses data to predict how much e-waste from smartphones Bangladesh will have by 2030 and how material we can recover from these phones. We proposed a system for handling smartphones a reverse supply chain framework that supports a formal network for collecting and processing old phones. This framework is based on the idea of Extended Producer Responsibility and integrates with existing supply chains. Our forecast shows that by 2030 Bangladesh could have between 12,700 and 73,400 tons of e-waste from smartphones every year. This e-waste contains a lot of materials like gold, copper and aluminum which can be put back into use instead of being thrown away. We can recover thousands of kilograms of gold and hundreds of tons of copper and aluminum. The paper concludes with a proposed preliminary data collection instrument for future empirical validation of the model.

title: Tax Knowledge, Tax Literacy, Learning Motivation, and Students’ Tax Understanding
abstractText: This study examines how tax knowledge, tax literacy, and learning motivation relate to tax understanding among tax accounting students at Politeknik Negeri Lampung. Primary data from 122 students in the 2022 and 2023 cohorts, selected through purposive sampling, were collected using a 16-item Likert-scale questionnaire and analyzed using multiple linear regression. Tax knowledge (β = 0.408, p < 0.001) and learning motivation (β = 0.268, p = 0.001) were positively and significantly associated with tax understanding, whereas tax literacy had a positive but nonsignificant coefficient (β = 0.166, p = 0.061). Jointly, the three variables were significant and explained 44.1% of the variation in tax understanding. Tax understanding is associated mainly with conceptual knowledge and sustained motivation to learn, while tax literacy acts as a supporting capability. The findings direct study programs to prioritize conceptual reinforcement and learning motivation and to embed literacy activities in case-based application. The purposive sample comes from one study program and all variables were measured with short self-report scales in a cross-sectional questionnaire, so the results indicate associations and cannot be generalized to all students.

title: Site-Controlled Incorporation of a Single Degradable Junction in RAFT Polymers for Tailored Block and Graft Copolymers
abstractText: Abstract The precise installation of cleavable junctions at defined positions within synthetic polymers remains a significant challenge, limiting the development of materials with degradation profiles akin to natural biopolymers. Herein, we report a novel strategy using reversible addition–fragmentation chain-transfer (RAFT) polymerization to insert a single 5,6-benzo-2-methylene-1,3-dioxepane (BMDO) unit precisely at the junction points of block and graft copolymers via a single-unit monomer insertion (SUMI) approach. This single ester-containing linkage enables selective cleavage, allowing efficient dissociation of block copolymers into their constituent blocks and detachment of grafts from molecular brush backbones. Our method transforms degradation from a non-specific process into a targeted, junction-specific event, providing a modular platform for the design of smart materials with triggered dissociation capabilities for potential applications in degradable surfactants, responsive coatings, and delivery systems.

Thermodynamic Insights and Multiobjective Optimization for Toluene/Acetonitrile/Hexane Ternary System under Varying Feed Compositions
abstractText: Abstract This work explores the separation processes for toluene/acetonitrile/hexane (Serafimov class 2.0–2b-B) in the full concentration range. While previous studies on class 2.0–2b-B systems primarily examined fixed feed compositions or relied on single conventional configurations, different heterogeneous azeotropic separation processes of toluene/acetonitrile/hexane mixtures under different feed compositions are studied in this work. The feed region is divided into two blocks by a line connecting the unstable node with the lowest temperature and the stable node with the highest temperature. Consequently, with the feed located to the right of line AC, the heterogeneous azeotropic distillation with direct separation process (HAD-DS) is proposed. In contrast, with the feed located to the left, conventional heterogeneous azeotropic distillation process (HAD-CON), HAD process with partial HEX reflux (HAD-PHR), and HAD process with partial OH reflux (HAD–OHR) are proposed. Subsequently, a multiobjective optimization algorithm and TOPSIS method are employed to minimize TAC, CO2 emissions, and exergy loss. When the feed composition is situated to the right side of the AC line and the feed composition is 0.4 HEX/0.4 TL/0.2 ACN, the TAC of the optimized HAD-DS process is 4.59 × 105 \$/y, exergy loss is 343.80 kW, and CO2 emission is 457.96 kg/h. When the feed composition is situated to left and the feed composition is 0.3 HEX/0.4 TL/0.3 ACN. Compared with HAD-CON, HAD–OHR process reduces TAC, CO2 emissions and exergy loss by 34.51%, 39.53% and 41.56%, respectively.

title: Hilbert space approach for general parabolic equations with variable coefficients in space and time
abstractText: We study an inverse source problem for a general linear parabolic equation with time--space dependent coefficients $a_{ij}(x,t)$, $b_i(x,t)$, and $c(x,t)$. The forward solution operator $S:f\mapsto u$ is stable, while recovery of the source from noisy observations of the state is an inverse problem. In the time-independent diagonal benchmark considered below, $S$ is compact; for fully non-autonomous coefficients the same conclusion requires the usual additional parabolic smoothing/compact-embedding hypotheses on the chosen observation map. The forward map is stable; the inverse is unstable when the observation operator is compact. We use the evolution family for the coupled system and the singular system of the observation operator for regularization. The numerical test uses space--time dependent coefficients and noisy terminal data. The resulting framework separates the general non-autonomous forward representation from the additional assumptions needed for inverse regularization.

title: Exploring AI Literacy Self-Efficacy among Pre-Service EFL Teachers: A Case Study in the Vietnamese Context
abstractText: This case study aims to explore Vietnamese pre-service EFL teachers' awareness of AI literacy, their AI self-efficacy, and developmental needs. Using an explanatory mixed-methods approach, data were collected through a questionnaire administered to 85 pre-service EFL teachers and follow-up interviews with 08 of them at a public university offering initial teacher education in central Vietnam. The findings show that these pre-service teachers were generally familiar with the concept of AI literacy, well-aware of its role in EFL instruction, and strongly supported the inclusion of formal AI literacy training in teacher education programs. In addition, they perceived self-efficacy of AI literacy to be moderate, particularly in dimensions such as a human-centered mindset and AI application. However, these pre-service teachers still needed more structured, practice-oriented support to develop their AI competence, with a preferred mode of blended training. These findings can provide insights into pre-service teachers’ perceptions of their self-efficacy in AI-assisted language education and inform the design and delivery of targeted AI literacy training for teacher education programs.

title: Concept “SAC” and Its Psychological and Pedagogical Significance
abstractText: The aim of the study was to determine the effectiveness of the integrated teaching approach regarding the formation of students’ knowledge of quantum biophysics and socio-adaptive skills. For that purpose, three methods were used: analysis of scientific literature to confirm the concept of SAC, and an experimental study involving 60 students to confirm the effectiveness of the integrated teaching method combining the study of quantum biophysical and psychosomatic aspects of education. The theoretical analysis established that the concept of socio-adaptive competence includes three main components – cognitive, emotional, and motivational – and clarified their interrelationship in the process of forming socio-adaptive competence. Furthermore, specific psychodidactic principles and forms of applying the concept within academic courses were identified, ensuring the integration of theoretical knowledge and practical skills. Active engagement with complex quantum biophysical concepts stimulates students’ cognitive processes, increases attentional focus by 28-41%, and fosters self-control skills, while concurrently reducing stress responses (r=-0.31 to -0.42) and enhancing emotional stability (r=0.28-0.38) and cognitive concentration (r=0.33-0.41). It was determined that the integration of psychodidactic principles with practical tasks ensures an optimal interaction between the psyche and physiology, which contributes to an increase in socio-adaptive competence and material retention by 62-68% in the experimental group. The author’s exercises develop cognitive, emotional, and motivational competencies, promote critical thinking, self-regulation, and socio-adaptive behaviour in students. The results can be utilised by educators, educational institution administrators, curriculum developers, and researchers for the implementation and assessment of the development of socio-emotional competence in teachers, with the aim of improving the quality of education, the effectiveness of the learning process, and the psychological well-being of participants in the educational environment.

Educaplay-Assisted Gamification and Learning Interest in PAI: A Case Study at SMP Islam Matholiul Falah
abstractText: Lecture-dominated Islamic Religious Education (PAI) classes can leave students passive. This qualitative descriptive-analytical case study examines Educaplay-assisted gamification in a Grade IX PAI class at SMP Islam Matholiul Falah Nglengkir Bogorejo, perceived changes in learning interest, and implementation factors. Observation, interviews, and documents from the PAI teacher, 15 students, the principal, and the deputy principal for curriculum were analyzed using the Miles–Huberman–Saldaña model and triangulation. Interest was considered through enjoyment, curiosity, attention, engagement, and willingness to learn. The teacher planned Educaplay in the teaching module, used it in core activities, and evaluated through scores, observation, and reflection. Accounts and observations suggested greater attention, participation, discussion, and efforts to improve scores; these are perceived changes, not proven effects. Support included MGMP encouragement, teacher readiness, a smart TV, and Wi-Fi; constraints included one shared screen, unstable internet, and uneven digital skills. The study documents implementation processes and school-level conditions

Manchester Proteome Profiler: A User-Friendly Platform for Quantitative Proteomic Analysis
abstractText: Abstract Manchester Proteome Profiler (MPP) is an open-source R Shiny application that streamlines the downstream analysis of quantitative proteomic data. Compatible with grouped protein intensities tables from MaxQuant, FragPipe, Proteome Discoverer, and other custom layouts, MPP provides an integrated platform for filtering, normalization, imputation, differential expression analysis, and cluster analysis across user-chosen experimental conditions. MPP supports both single- and dual-data set comparisons, incorporates SAINTexpress for affinity purification and proximity labeling experiments, and enables downstream analysis of the significant protein list clusters to functional enrichment and interaction networks via Gene Ontology, BioGRID, and STRING. Benchmarking with a KRAS proximity biotinylation data set demonstrated the ability of MPP to identify reproducible clusters of differentially expressed proteins and reveal biologically meaningful patterns, including enrichment of solute carrier transporters and adhesion molecules. With interactive visualizations, customizable reports, and support for complex experimental designs, MPP offers a novel, versatile, and user-friendly environment for proteomic data exploration and hypothesis generation.

title: Small actions, big changes: a mixed investigation of a school curriculum for sustainable development in high school
abstractText: This paper investigates the contribution of a school activities program to the cultivation of knowledge, attitudes and behavior of high school students regarding sustainable development. The program “Small actions, big changes: for a sustainable future” was implemented in a public high school in an urban area, with 26 high school students. The intervention was linked to Sustainable Development Goals 11, 12, 13, 14 and 15 and included school paper and plastic recycling, student responsibility and an educational visit to waste management facilities. A mixed methodological approach was adopted, with a pre- and post-program questionnaire, observation and reflective notes. The triangulation of data allowed the cross-referencing of quantitative trends with the experiential participation of students. The findings show an enhancement of the understanding of sustainability, responsible consumption and the intention to actively participate in the school community.

title: Beyond Equilibrium: Tracing Redox-Driven Pathways That Shape Aqueous and Mineral Chemistry
abstractText: Abstract Numerous aqueous and geochemical systems host elements in multiple redox states, with wide ranging implications such as their influence on the formation/dissolution of minerals, water toxicity, and nutrient cycling. To uncover governing mechanisms and complex chemical interactions in geochemical systems, reactive-transport models have increasingly gained importance. However, their predictive capabilities remain limited because existing approaches struggle to accurately account for the full complexities of redox reactions. Here, we develop a reactive-transport framework that leverages recent advances in thermodynamic modeling, speciation chemistry, and redox kinetics. Distinct from traditional models, we uniquely treat redox kinetics along with transport as transient phenomena, decoupled from Gibbs free energy minimization. By ensuring ionic concentrations are governed by nonequilibrium rate laws, this approach allows predicting the tempo-spatial distribution of speciation and precipitation of species across oxidation states. We illustrate the versatility of our framework through two case studies: manganese speciation in natural waters and the fate of dissolved iron in aqueous/porous media. Our framework significantly enhances the modeling of a diverse range of redox-sensitive environments.

title: Evaluación Comparativa de Filtros de Alto Caudal y Filtros Plisados en el Tratamiento de Agua Potable: Eficiencia, Costos y Mantenimiento.
abstractText: Las empresas manufactureras requieren características específicas del agua como materia prima en sus procesos, los cuales son parte de la base de los elementos producidos. El objetivo es evaluar la eficiencia de los filtros de alto caudal frente a los filtros plisados en el tratamiento de agua potable, analizando su rendimiento, costos operativos y mantenimiento, con el fin de determinar cuál tecnología es más adecuada para su implementación en plantas de tratamiento de agua. Se enmarca dentro del paradigma cuantitativo bajo el tipo de investigación experimental, se presenta en el seguimiento del comportamiento mediante el diferencial de presiones que lo llamaremos Delta de presión (ΔP), sólidos totales disueltos (STD), caudal. Los resultados de los exámenes de laboratorio al agua indican que en ambos sistemas de pulido (plisados-Alto caudal) no existe ausencia de coliformes fecales. Una revisión detallada de las tecnologías de filtración más comunes en el tratamiento de agua potable, en particular los filtros de alto caudal y los filtros plisados. Los estudios previos indican que, aunque ambos tipos de filtros son eficaces, existen diferencias clave en cuanto a eficiencia, costos operativos y mantenimiento, que pueden influir en su elección dependiendo del contexto operativo de las plantas de tratamiento de agua. Esta revisión sugiere la necesidad de una evaluación comparativa para proporcionar recomendaciones más específicas sobre cuál de estas tecnologías es más adecuada para diferentes condiciones de operación.

Experimental Study and Physics-Informed Machine Learning on Sustainable Concrete Using Sugarcane Bagasse Ash and Distilled Sewage Water
abstractText: The increasing environmental burden associated with cement production and freshwater consumption has created a need for sustainable alternatives in concrete production. This study investigates the combined utilization of Sugarcane Bagasse Ash (SCBA) as a partial cement replacement and Distilled SewageWater (DSW) as an alternative mixing-water source in M25–grade concrete. Seven concrete mixtures (M0–M6) were prepared by incorporating 0–30% SCBA and 0–40% DSW while maintaining a constant binder content of 400 kg/m3 and water-to-binder ratio of 0.50. Compressive strength was experimentally evaluated after 7, 14, and 28 days of curing. The results demonstrated that moderate replacement levels improved strength, with the mixture containing 10% SCBA and 20% DSW achieving the highest compressive strengths of 20.8, 26.1, and 34.2 MPa at 7, 14, and 28 days, respectively. The improvement was attributed to the pozzolanic activity and micro-filler effect of SCBA, together with adequate water availability. Higher replacement levels resulted in strength reduction because of cement dilution and reduced calcium hydroxide availability. Furthermore, Artificial Neural Network (ANN) and Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) models were developed to predict compressive strength using key mix–design parameters and curing age. Both models exhibited excellent predictive performance, with R2 values exceeding 0.999 during the evaluated stages. ANN provided slightly higher numerical accuracy, whereas PINN demonstrated more consistent validation and testing behaviour, indicating improved generalisation and physical consistency. The findings demonstrate that the integrated experimental, physics-informed modelling, and explainable–AI framework can support the development and optimization of sustainable SCBA–DSW concrete while reducing dependence on conventional cement and freshwater resources.

ANALISIS BIBLIOMETRIK APLIKASI DAN TREN PENELITIAN FEED ADDITIVE DALAM DUNIA PETERNAKAN
abstractText: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis secara komprehensif perkembangan dan tren penelitian terkait penggunaan feed additive dalam dunia peternakan melalui pendekatan bibliometrik. Data dikumpulkan menggunakan perangkat lunak Publish or Perish 8 berbasis Google Scholar dengan rentang waktu publikasi tahun 2020–2026, kemudian diseleksi menggunakan Mendeley dan dianalisis menggunakan VOSviewer. Sebanyak 1.247 dokumen yang memenuhi kriteria dianalisis untuk mengidentifikasi tren publikasi, jaringan kolaborasi, serta klaster tematik penelitian. Hasil analisis menunjukkan adanya peningkatan signifikan jumlah publikasi, terutama setelah pelarangan antibiotic growth promoter (AGP) secara global. Visualisasi jaringan mengidentifikasi empat klaster utama, yaitu (1) performa broiler dan feed additive, (2) enzim dan ternak ruminansia, (3) produksi unggas dan nutrisi, serta (4) probiotik dan prebiotik. Analisis kepadatan mengungkap bahwa topik broiler growth performance dan enzyme supplementation menjadi fokus utama penelitian, sementara topik seperti postbiotic dan aplikasi pada ternak minor masih relatif terbatas. Analisis tren temporal menunjukkan bahwa enzim dan postbiotik merupakan topik yang berkembang pesat dalam beberapa tahun terakhir. Temuan ini menegaskan bahwa penelitian feed additive berada dalam fase dinamis dengan arah menuju pendekatan berbasis mikrobiota dan keberlanjutan. Penelitian ini memberikan kontribusi penting dalam memetakan lanskap penelitian global serta mengidentifikasi peluang riset di masa depan dalam bidang nutrisi ternak.

title: PENGARUH KUALITAS PELAYANAN DAN PERSEPSI HARGA TERHADAP LOYALITAS PENGGUNA KRL PADA PEKERJA GEN-Z KOMUTER RUTE DEPOK-JAKARTA
abstractText: Tingginya tingkat mobilitas komuter pekerja Generasi Z di lintasan Depok–Jakarta mendorong kebutuhan akan moda transportasi umum yang efisien, andal, dan ekonomis demi menjaga ketahanan loyalitas konsumen. Riset ini dilakukan guna mengevaluasi dampak kualitas pelayanan serta persepsi harga terhadap loyalitas penumpang KRL pada segmen pekerja muda komuter rute Depok–Jakarta. Melalui pendekatan kuantitatif statistik dengan analisis data didasarkan pada survei kuesioner kepada responden yang relevan sebanyak 125 orang. Populasi penelitian adalah para pengguna jasa transportasi kereta komuter rute Depok – Jakarta. Responden yang memenuhi kriteria sebagai sampel menjawab kuesioner yang menyajikan pilihan jawaban sesuai yang telah ditentukan. Data yang telah terkumpul dari responden di uji intrumen, uji asumsi klasik, uji linear berganda, uji hipotesis dan uji determinasi menggunakan perangkat lunak SPSS versi 27. Tahapan pengujian mencakup evaluasi instrumen, pemenuhan asumsi klasik, pembuktian hipotesis, dan kalkulasi koefisien determinasi. Temuan penelitian mengindikasikan bahwa kualitas pelayanan tidak memberikan pengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap loyalitas. Sebaliknya, persepsi harga terbukti berpengaruh positif, signifikan, serta menjadi kontributor paling dominan. Secara serentak, kualitas pelayanan dan persepsi harga berpengaruh signifikan terhadap loyalitas pengguna KRL Pada Pekerja Gen-Z Komuter Rute Depok-Jakarta. Implikasi praktis dari studi ini menekankan pentingnya bagi operator untuk memelihara ketersediaan tarif terjangkau serta efisiensi waktu guna memelihara loyalitas pengguna muda.

Turning Readily Available Acrylates into Cyclic Xanthates for Radical Ring-Opening Polymerizations
abstractText: Abstract Cyclic sulfur-containing monomers represent a promising class of comonomers for radical ring-opening polymerization, but only a limited number of examples have been reported to date. Here, the cyclic xanthate tert-butyl 2-thioxo-1,3-oxathiolane-5-carboxylate (Oxa) was synthesized from readily available tert-butyl acrylate via epoxidation and subsequent ring extension with carbon disulfide. While homopolymerization was not observed, efficient copolymerization with vinyl acetate yielded copolymers containing dithiocarbonate units in the polymer backbone. Reactivity ratio analysis revealed a preference for heteropropagation, enabling efficient incorporation of dithiocarbonate units with Oxa contents of up to 40 mol %, at which compositions the copolymers displayed a tendency toward an alternating microstructure. The resulting copolymers were highly transparent and colorless and exhibited molar masses and glass transition temperatures comparable to those of poly(vinyl acetate). The incorporated dithiocarbonate units enabled selective backbone cleavage by aminolysis, base-mediated hydrolysis, or oxidative degradation, whereas acidic conditions (0.5 M HCl) did not affect the polymers. Copolymers containing at least 25 mol % Oxa generated low-molar-mass degradation products, confirming the efficient incorporation of degradable units into the polymer chains. These results establish cyclic xanthates derived from a readily accessible acrylate precursor as a versatile platform for introducing chemically degradable dithiocarbonate functionalities into vinyl acetate-based polymers.
